verses.am: የጋይንም ንጉሥ ሳይሞት ይዘው ወደ ኢያሱ አመጡት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''Israël eut achevé de tuer tous les habitants d''Aï dans la campagne, dans le désert, où ils l''avaient poursuivi, et que tous furent entièrement passés au fil de l''épée, tout Israël revint vers Aï et la frappa du tranchant de l''épée.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እስራኤልን ሊያሳድዱ ሄደው የነበሩትን የጋይን ሰዎች ሁሉ በሜዳና በምድረ በዳ ከገደሉአቸው በኋላ፥ እነርሱም በሰይፍ ስለት እስኪያልቁ ድረስ ከወደቁ በኋላ፥ እስራኤል ሁሉ ወደ ጋይ ተመለሱ፥ በሰይፍም ስለት መቱአት።

verses.en: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
verses.fr: Il y eut au total douze mille personnes tuées ce jour-là, hommes et femmes, tous gens d''Aï.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የወደቁት ሁሉ ወንድም ሴትም የጋይ ሰዎች ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ ነፍስ ነበሩ።

verses.en: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
verses.fr: Josué ne retira point sa main qu''il tenait étendue avec le javelot, jusqu''à ce que tous les habitants eussent été dévoués par interdit.
verses.am: ኢያሱም በጋይ የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ፈጽሞ እስኪያጠፋ ድረስ ጦር የዘረጋባትን እጁን አላጠፈም።

verses.en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the Lord which he commanded Joshua.
verses.fr: Seulement Israël garda pour lui le bétail et le butin de cette ville, selon l''ordre que l''Eternel avait prescrit à Josué.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ኢያሱን እንዳዘዘው ቃል የዚያችን ከተማ ከብትና ምርኮ እስራኤል ለራሳቸው ዘረፉ።

verses.en: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.
verses.fr: Josué brûla Aï, et en fit à jamais un monceau de ruines, qui subsiste encore aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ጋይን አቃጠላት፥ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ድብድባና በረሃ ለዘላለም አደረጋት።

verses.en: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.
verses.fr: Il fit pendre à un bois le roi d''Aï, et l''y laissa jusqu''au soir. Au coucher du soleil, Josué ordonna qu''on descendît son cadavre du bois; on le jeta à l''entrée de la porte de la ville, et l''on éleva sur lui un grand monceau de pierres, qui subsiste encore aujourd''hui.
verses.am: የጋይንም ንጉሥ እስከ ማታ ድረስ በዛፍ ላይ ሰቀለው፤ ፀሐይም በገባች ጊዜ ኢያሱ አዘዘ፥ ሬሳውንም ከዛፍ አወረዱት፥ በከተማይቱም በር አደባባይ ጣሉት፥ በላዩም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያለውን ታላቅ የድንጋይ ክምር ከመሩበት።

verses.en: Then Joshua built an altar unto the Lord God of Israel in mount Ebal,
verses.fr: Alors Josué bâtit un autel à l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, sur le mont Ebal,
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜም ኢያሱ በጌባል ተራራ ላይ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያን ሠራ።

verses.en: As Moses the servant of the Lord commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the Lord, and sacrificed peace offerings.
verses.fr: comme Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, l''avait ordonné aux enfants d''Israël, et comme il est écrit dans le livre de la loi de Moïse: c''était un autel de pierres brutes, sur lesquelles on ne porta point le fer. Ils offrirent sur cet autel des holocaustes à l''Eternel, et ils présentèrent des sacrifices d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዳዘዘ፥ በሙሴም ሕግ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈው፥ መሠዊያው ካልተወቀረና ብረት ካልነካው ድንጋይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አቀረቡ፥ የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት ሠዉ።

verses.en: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Et là Josué écrivit sur les pierres une copie de la loi que Moïse avait écrite devant les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሲያዩ በዚያ ስፍራ በድንጋዮቹ ላይ የሙሴን ሕግ ጻፈባቸው።

verses.en: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.
verses.fr: Tout Israël, ses anciens, ses officiers et ses juges, se tenaient des deux côtés de l''arche, devant les sacrificateurs, les Lévites, qui portaient l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel; les étrangers comme les enfants d''Israël étaient là, moitié du côté du mont Garizim, moitié du côté du mont Ebal, selon l''ordre qu''avait précédemment donné Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, de bénir le peuple d''Israël.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም ሕዝብ አስቀድሞ ይባርኩ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘ፥ እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ሽማግሌዎቻቸውም፥ አለቆቻቸውም፥ ፈራጆቻቸውም፥ የአገሩ ልጆችም፥ መጻተኞችም፥ እኩሌቶቹ በገሪዛን ተራራ ፊት እኩሌቶቹም በጌባል ተራራ ፊት ሆነው፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት በተሸከሙት በሌዋውያን ካህናት ፊት ለፊት፥ በታቦቱም ፊት በወዲህና በወዲያ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
verses.fr: Josué lut ensuite toutes les paroles de la loi, les bénédictions et les malédictions, suivant ce qui est écrit dans le livre de la loi.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ በሕጉ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈ ሁሉ፥ የሕጉን ቃሎች ሁሉ በረከቱንና እርግማኑን አነበበ።

verses.en: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.
verses.fr: Il n''y eut rien de tout ce que Moïse avait prescrit, que Josué ne lût en présence de toute l''assemblée d''Israël, des femmes et des enfants, et des étrangers qui marchaient au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: ኢያሱም በእስራኤል ጉባኤ ሁሉ በሴቶቹም በሕፃናቱም በመካከላቸውም በሚኖሩት መጻተኞች ፊት ሁሉን አነበበ እንጂ ሙሴ ካዘዘው አንዲት ቃል አላስቀረም። a

verses.en: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;
verses.fr: A la nouvelle de ces choses, tous les rois qui étaient en deçà du Jourdain, dans la montagne et dans la vallée, et sur toute la côte de la grande mer, jusque près du Liban, les Héthiens, les Amoréens, les Cananéens, les Phéréziens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በተራራማው በቈላውም በታላቁ ባሕር ዳር በሊባኖስም ፊት ለፊት የነበሩ ነገሥታት ሁሉ፥ ኬጢያዊ አሞራዊም ከነዓናዊም ፌርዛዊም ኤዊያዊም ኢያቡሳዊም፥ ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
verses.fr: s''unirent ensemble d''un commun accord pour combattre contre Josué et contre Israël.
verses.am: ኢያሱንና እስራኤልን ሊወጉ አንድ ሆነው ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
verses.fr: Les habitants de Gabaon, de leur côté, lorsqu''ils apprirent de quelle manière Josué avait traité Jéricho et Aï,
verses.am: የገባዖን ሰዎች ግን ኢያሱ በኢያሪኮና በጋይ ያደረገውን በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
verses.fr: eurent recours à la ruse, et se mirent en route avec des provisions de voyage. Ils prirent de vieux sacs pour leurs ânes, et de vieilles outres à vin déchirées et recousues,
verses.am: እነርሱ ደግሞ ተንኰል አደረጉ፤ ለራሳቸውም ስንቅ ያዙ፥ በአህዮቻቸውም ላይ አሮጌ ዓይበትና ያረጀና የተቀደደ የተጠቀመም የጠጅ አቁማዳ ጫኑ።

verses.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
verses.fr: ils portaient à leurs pieds de vieux souliers raccommodés, et sur eux de vieux vêtements; et tout le pain qu''ils avaient pour nourriture était sec et en miettes.
verses.am: ያረጀ የተጠቀመም ጫማ በእግራቸው አደረጉ አሮጌም ልብስ ለበሱ፤ ለስንቅም የያዙት እንጀራ ሁሉ የደረቀና የሻገተ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.
verses.fr: Ils allèrent auprès de Josué au camp de Guilgal, et ils lui dirent, ainsi qu''à tous ceux d''Israël: Nous venons d''un pays éloigné, et maintenant faites alliance avec nous.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ወደ ሰፈረበት ወደ ጌልገላ ሄደው ለእርሱና ለእስራኤል ሰዎች። ከሩቅ አገር መጥተናል፤ አሁንም ከእኛ ጋር ኪዳን አድርጉ አሉ።

verses.en: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
verses.fr: Les hommes d''Israël répondirent à ces Héviens: Peut-être que vous habitez au milieu de nous, et comment ferions-nous alliance avec vous?
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ኤዊያውያንን። ምናልባት በመካከላችን የምትቀመጡ እንደ ሆነ እንዴትስ ከእናንተ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን እናደርጋለን? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?
verses.fr: Ils dirent à Josué: Nous sommes tes serviteurs. Et Josué leur dit: Qui êtes-vous, et d''où venez-vous?
verses.am: ኢያሱንም። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ነን አሉት። ኢያሱም። እናንተ እነማን ናችሁ? ከወዴትስ መጣችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the Lord thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Tes serviteurs viennent d''un pays très éloigné, sur le renom de l''Eternel, ton Dieu; car nous avons entendu parler de lui, de tout ce qu''il a fait en Egypte,
verses.am: እነርሱም አሉት። ከአምላክህ ከእግዚአብሔር ስም የተነሣ እጅግ ከራቀ አገር ባሪያዎችህ መጥተናል፤ ዝናውንም፥ በግብፅም ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
verses.fr: et de la manière dont il a traité les deux rois des Amoréens au delà du Jourdain, Sihon, roi de Hesbon, et Og, roi de Basan, qui était à Aschtaroth.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶም በነበሩት በሁለቱ በአሞራውያን ነገሥታት በሐሴቦን ንጉሥ በሴዎን በአስታሮትም በነበረው በባሳን ንጉሥ በዐግ ያደረገውን ሁሉ ሰምተናል።

verses.en: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.
verses.fr: Et nos anciens et tous les habitants de notre pays nous ont dit: Prenez avec vous des provisions pour le voyage, allez au-devant d''eux, et vous leur direz: Nous sommes vos serviteurs, et maintenant faites alliance avec nous.
verses.am: ሽማግሌዎቻችንም በምድራችንም የሚኖሩት ሁሉ። ለመንገድ ስንቅ በእጃችሁ ያዙ፥ ልትገናኙአቸውም ሂዱ። እኛ ባሪያዎቻችሁ ነን፤ አሁንም ከእኛ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አድርጉ በሉአቸው አሉን።

verses.en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
verses.fr: Voici notre pain: il était encore chaud quand nous en avons fait provision dans nos maisons, le jour où nous sommes partis pour venir vers vous, et maintenant il est sec et en miettes.
verses.am: ወደ እናንተ ለመምጣት በተነሣንበት ቀን ይህን እንጀራ ትኩሱን ለስንቅ ከቤታችን ወሰድነው፤ አሁንም እነሆ፥ ደርቆአል፥ ሻግቶአልም።

verses.en: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
verses.fr: Ces outres à vin, que nous avons remplies toutes neuves, les voilà déchirées; nos vêtements et nos souliers se sont usés par l''excessive longueur de la marche.
verses.am: እነዚህም የጠጅ አቁማዳዎች አዲስ ሳሉ ሞላንባቸው፤ እነሆም፥ ተቀድደዋል፤ መንገዳችንም እጅግ ስለ ራቀብን እነዚህ ልብሶቻችንና ጫማዎቻችን አርጅተዋል።

verses.en: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the Lord.
verses.fr: Les hommes d''Israël prirent de leurs provisions, et ils ne consultèrent point l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ከስንቃቸው ወሰዱ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አልጠየቁም።

verses.en: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
verses.fr: Josué fit la paix avec eux, et conclut une alliance par laquelle il devait leur laisser la vie, et les chefs de l''assemblée le leur jurèrent.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከእነርሱ ጋር ሰላም አደረገ፥ በሕይወት እንዲተዋቸውም ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ፤ የማኅበሩም አለቆች ማሉላቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
verses.fr: Trois jours après la conclusion de cette alliance, les enfants d''Israël apprirent qu''ils étaient leurs voisins, et qu''ils habitaient au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ካደረጉ ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ ጎረቤቶቻቸው እንደ ሆኑ በመካከላቸውም እንደ ኖሩ ሰሙ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjathjearim.
verses.fr: Car les enfants d''Israël partirent, et arrivèrent à leurs villes le troisième jour; leurs villes étaient Gabaon, Kephira, Beéroth et Kirjath-Jearim.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተጕዘው በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ ከተሞቻቸው መጡ፤ የከተሞቻቸውም ስም ገባዖን፥ ከፊራ፥ ብኤሮት፥ ቂርያትይዓሪም ነበረ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
verses.fr: Ils ne les frappèrent point, parce que les chefs de l''assemblée leur avaient juré par l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, de leur laisser la vie. Mais toute l''assemblée murmura contre les chefs.
verses.am: የሕዝቡም አለቆች በእስራኤል አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ስለ ማሉላቸው የእስራኤል ልጆች አልመቱአቸውም። ማኅበሩም ሁሉ በአለቆቹ ላይ አጕረመረሙ።

verses.en: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.
verses.fr: Et tous les chefs dirent à toute l''assemblée: Nous leur avons juré par l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, et maintenant nous ne pouvons les toucher.
verses.am: አለቆቹም ሁሉ ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ። በእስራኤል አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ምለንላቸዋል፤ ስለዚህም እንነካቸው ዘንድ አይገባንም።

verses.en: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
verses.fr: Voici comment nous les traiterons: nous leur laisserons la vie, afin de ne pas attirer sur nous la colère de l''Eternel, à cause du serment que nous leur avons fait.
verses.am: ስለ ማልንላቸው መሓላ ቍጣ እንዳይወርድብን ይህን እናድርግባቸው፥ በሕይወትም እንተዋቸው አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
verses.fr: Ils vivront, leur dirent les chefs. Mais ils furent employés à couper le bois et à puiser l''eau pour toute l''assemblée, comme les chefs le leur avaient dit.
verses.am: አለቆቹም። በሕይወት ይኑሩ አሉአቸው፤ አለቆቹም እንደ ተናገሩአቸው ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ እንጨት ቆራጮች ውኃም ቀጂዎች ሆኑ።

verses.en: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?
verses.fr: Josué les fit appeler, et leur parla ainsi: Pourquoi nous avez-vous trompés, en disant: Nous sommes très éloignés de vous, tandis que vous habitez au milieu de nous?
verses.am: ኢያሱም ጠርቶ። እናንተ በመካከላችን ስትኖሩ። ከእናንተ እጅግ የራቅን ነን ብላችሁ ለምን አታለላችሁን?

verses.en: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.
verses.fr: Maintenant vous êtes maudits, et vous ne cesserez point d''être dans la servitude, de couper le bois et de puiser l''eau pour la maison de mon Dieu.
verses.am: አሁንም የተረገማችሁ ናችሁ፤ ለአምላኬም ቤት እንጨት ቈራጭ ውኃም ቀጂ የሆነ ባሪያ ከእናንተ ለዘላለም አይጠፋም አላቸው።

verses.en: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the Lord thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent à Josué, et dirent: On avait rapporté à tes serviteurs les ordres de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, à Moïse, son serviteur, pour vous livrer tout le pays et pour en détruire devant vous tous les habitants, et votre présence nous a inspiré une grande crainte pour notre vie: voilà pourquoi nous avons agi de la sorte.
verses.am: መልሰውም ኢያሱን። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ይሰጣችሁ ዘንድ፥ በእርስዋም የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ ያጠፋ ዘንድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ባሪያውን ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ በእውነት ሰምተናል፥ ስለዚህም ከእናንተ የተነሣ ስለ ነፍሳችን እጅግ ፈራን፥ ይህንንም ነገር አድርገናል።

verses.en: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
verses.fr: Et maintenant nous voici entre tes mains; traite-nous comme tu trouveras bon et juste de nous traiter.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ በእጅህ ውስጥ ነን፤ ለዓይንህም መልካምና ቅን የመሰለውን ነገር አድርግብን አሉት።

verses.en: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.
verses.fr: Josué agit à leur égard comme il avait été décidé; il les délivra de la main des enfants d''Israël, qui ne les firent pas mourir;
verses.am: እንዲሁም አደረገባቸው፥ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች እጅ አዳናቸው፥ አልገደሉአቸውምም።

verses.en: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the Lord, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
verses.fr: mais il les destina dès ce jour à couper le bois et à puiser l''eau pour l''assemblée, et pour l''autel de l''Eternel dans le lieu que l''Eternel choisirait: ce qu''ils font encore aujourd''hui.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ኢያሱ ለማኅበሩ በመረጠውም ስፍራ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ እንጨት ቈራጮች ውኃም ቀጂዎች አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, when Adonizedec king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;
verses.fr: Adoni-Tsédek, roi de Jérusalem, apprit que Josué s''était emparé d''Aï et l''avait dévouée par interdit, qu''il avait traité Aï et son roi comme il avait traité Jéricho et son roi, et que les habitants de Gabaon avaient fait la paix avec Israël et étaient au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ንጉሥ አዶኒጼዴቅ ኢያሱ ጋይን እንደ ያዘ ፈጽሞም እንዳጠፋት፥ በኢያሪኮና በንጉሥዋም ያደረገውን እንዲሁ በጋይና በንጉሥዋ እንዳደረገ፥ የገባዖንም ሰዎች ከእስራኤል ጋር ሰላም እንዳደረጉ በመካከላቸውም እንደ ሆኑ በሰማ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
verses.fr: Il eut alors une forte crainte; car Gabaon était une grande ville, comme une des villes royales, plus grande même qu''Aï, et tous ses hommes étaient vaillants.
verses.am: ገባዖን ከመንግሥታት ከተሞች እንደ አንዲቱ ታላቅ ከተማ ስለ ሆነች፥ ከጋይም ስለ በለጠች፥ ሰዎችዋም ሁሉ ኃያላን ስለ ነበሩ፥ እጅግ ፈራ።

verses.en: Wherefore Adonizedec king of Jerusalem, sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.fr: Adoni-Tsédek, roi de Jérusalem, fit dire à Hoham, roi d''Hébron, à Piream, roi de Jarmuth, à Japhia, roi de Lakis, et à Debir, roi d''Eglon:
verses.am: ስለዚህም የኢየሩሳሌም ንጉሥ አዶኒጼዴቅ ወደ ኬብሮን ንጉሥ ወደ ሆሃም፥ ወደ የርሙት ንጉሥም ወደ ጲርአም፥ ወደ ለኪሶ ንጉሥም ወደ ያፊዓ፥ ወደ አዶላም ንጉሥም ወደ ዳቤር ልኮ። ወደ እኔ ውጡ፥

verses.en: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Montez vers moi, et aidez-moi, afin que nous frappions Gabaon, car elle a fait la paix avec Josué et avec les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ከኢያሱና ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ጋር ሰላም አድርገዋልና ገባዖንን ለመምታት አግዙኝ አለ።

verses.en: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
verses.fr: Cinq rois des Amoréens, le roi de Jérusalem, le roi d''Hébron, le roi de Jarmuth, le roi de Lakis, le roi d''Eglon, se réunirent ainsi et montèrent avec toutes leurs armées; ils vinrent camper près de Gabaon, et l''attaquèrent.
verses.am: አምስቱም የአሞራውያን ነገሥታት፥ የኢየሩሳሌም ንጉሥ፥ የኬብሮን ንጉሥ፥ የየርሙት ንጉሥ፥ የለኪሶ ንጉሥ፥ የአዶላም ንጉሥ፥ ከሠራዊቶቻቸው ሁሉ ጋር ተሰብስበው ወጡ፥ ከገባዖንም ጋር ሊጋጠሙ ከበቡአት።

verses.en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
verses.fr: Les gens de Gabaon envoyèrent dire à Josué, au camp de Guilgal: N''abandonne pas tes serviteurs, monte vers nous en hâte, délivre-nous, donne-nous du secours; car tous les rois des Amoréens, qui habitent la montagne, se sont réunis contre nous.
verses.am: የገባዖንም ሰዎች ኢያሱ ወደ ሰፈረበት ወደ ጌልገላ ልከው። ባሪያዎችህን ለመርዳት እጅህን አትመልስ፤ በተራራማው አገር የሚኖሩ የአሞራውያን ነገሥታት ሁሉ ተሰብስበውብናልና ፈጥነህ ወደ እኛ ውጣ አድነንም እርዳንም አሉት።

verses.en: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
verses.fr: Josué monta de Guilgal, lui et tous les gens de guerre avec lui, et tous les vaillants hommes.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ሰልፈኞች ሁሉ ጽኑዓን ኃያላኑም ሁሉ ከጌልገላ ወጡ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Josué: Ne les crains point, car je les livre entre tes mains, et aucun d''eux ne tiendra devant toi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን። በእጅህ አሳልፌ ሰጥቼአቸዋለሁና አትፍራቸው፤ ከእነርሱም አንድ ሰው የሚቋቋምህ የለም አለው።

verses.en: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
verses.fr: Josué arriva subitement sur eux, après avoir marché toute la nuit depuis Guilgal.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከጌልገላ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ገሥግሦ በድንገት መጣባቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Bethhoron, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
verses.fr: L''Eternel les mit en déroute devant Israël; et Israël leur fit éprouver une grande défaite près de Gabaon, les poursuivit sur le chemin qui monte à Beth-Horon, et les battit jusqu''à Azéka et à Makkéda.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ፊት አስደነገጣቸው፤ በገባዖንም ታላቅ መምታት መታቸው፥ በቤትሖሮንም ዐቀበት በመንገድ አሳደዳቸው፥ እስከ ዓዜቃና እስከ መቄዳ ድረስ መታቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Bethhoron, that the Lord cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.
verses.fr: Comme ils fuyaient devant Israël, et qu''ils étaient à la descente de Beth-Horon, l''Eternel fit tomber du ciel sur eux de grosses pierres jusqu''à Azéka, et ils périrent; ceux qui moururent par les pierres de grêle furent plus nombreux que ceux qui furent tués avec l''épée par les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ፊት እየሸሹ በቤትሖሮን ቍልቍለት ሲወርዱ፥ ወደ ዓዜቃ እስኪደርሱ ድረስ እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ ታላላቅ የበረዶ ድንጋይ አወረደባቸውና ሞቱ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች በሰይፍ ከገደሉአቸው ይልቅ በበረዶ ድንጋይ የሞቱት በለጡ።

verses.en: Then spake Joshua to the Lord in the day when the Lord delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
verses.fr: Alors Josué parla à l''Eternel, le jour où l''Eternel livra les Amoréens aux enfants d''Israël, et il dit en présence d''Israël: Soleil, arrête-toi sur Gabaon, Et toi, lune, sur la vallée d''Ajalon!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ልጆች እጅ አሞራውያንን አሳልፎ በሰጠ ቀን ኢያሱ እግዚአብሔርን ተናገረ፤ በእስራኤልም ፊት እንዲህ አለ። በገባዖን ላይ ፀሐይ ትቁም፥ በኤሎንም ሸለቆ ጨረቃ፤

verses.en: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
verses.fr: Et le soleil s''arrêta, et la lune suspendit sa course, Jusqu''à ce que la nation eût tiré vengeance de ses ennemis. Cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre du Juste? Le soleil s''arrêta au milieu du ciel, Et ne se hâta point de se coucher, presque tout un jour.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ጠላቶቻቸውን እስኪበቀሉ ድረስ ፀሐይ ቆመ፥ ጨረቃም ዘገየ። ይህስ በያሻር መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? ፀሐይም በሰማይ መካከል ዘገየ፥ አንድ ቀንም ሙሉ ያህል ለመግባት አልቸኰለም።

verses.en: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the Lord hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the Lord fought for Israel.
verses.fr: Il n''y a point eu de jour comme celui-là, ni avant ni après, où l''Eternel ait écouté la voix d''un homme; car l''Eternel combattait pour Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ይዋጋ ነበርና እግዚአብሔር የሰውን ቃል የሰማበት እንደዚያ ያለ ቀን ከዚያም በፊት ከዚያም በኋላ አልነበረም።

verses.en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.fr: Et Josué, et tout Israël avec lui, retourna au camp à Guilgal.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ ወደ ሰፈራቸው ወደ ጌልገላ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.fr: Les cinq rois s''enfuirent, et se cachèrent dans une caverne à Makkéda.
verses.am: እነዚህም አምስት ነገሥታት ሸሽተው በመቄዳ ዋሻ ተሸሸጉ።

verses.en: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.fr: On le rapporta à Josué, en disant: Les cinq rois se trouvent cachés dans une caverne à Makkéda.
verses.am: ለኢያሱም። አምስቱ ነገሥታት በመቄዳ ዋሻ ተሸሽገው ተገኙ ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
verses.fr: Josué dit: Roulez de grosses pierres à l''entrée de la caverne, et mettez-y des hommes pour les garder.
verses.am: ኢያሱም እንዲህ አለ። ወደ ዋሻው አፍ ታላላቅ ድንጋይ አንከባልላችሁ፥ ይጠብቁአቸው ዘንድ ሰዎችን በዚያ አኑሩ፤

verses.en: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the Lord your God hath delivered them into your hand.
verses.fr: Et vous, ne vous arrêtez pas, poursuivez vos ennemis, et attaquez-les par derrière; ne les laissez pas entrer dans leurs villes, car l''Eternel, votre Dieu, les a livrés entre vos mains.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን አትዘግዩ፥ ጠላቶቻችሁንም አባርሩአቸው፥ በኋላም ያሉትን ግደሉ፤ አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአቸዋልና ወደ ከተሞቻቸው እንዳይገቡ ከልክሉአቸው አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
verses.fr: Après que Josué et les enfants d''Israël leur eurent fait éprouver une très grande défaite, et les eurent complètement battus, ceux qui purent échapper se sauvèrent dans les villes fortifiées,
verses.am: እስኪጠፉም ድረስ ኢያሱና የእስራኤል ልጆች በታላቅ መምታት መምታታቸውን በፈጸሙ ጊዜ፥ ከእነርሱም ያመለጡት ወደ ተመሸገ ከተማ በገቡ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: et tout le peuple revint tranquillement au camp vers Josué à Makkéda, sans que personne remuât sa langue contre les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሕዝብ ሁሉ ኢያሱ ወደ ሰፈረበት ወደ መቄዳ በደኅና ተመለሱ፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ምላሱን ማንቀሳቀስ የደፈረ ማንም ሰው የለም።

verses.en: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
verses.fr: Josué dit alors: Ouvrez l''entrée de la caverne, faites-en sortir ces cinq rois, et amenez-les-moi.
verses.am: ኢያሱም። የዋሻውን አፍ ክፈቱ፥ እነዚያንም አምስት ነገሥታት ከዋሻው ወደ እኔ አውጡአቸው አለ።

verses.en: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.fr: Ils firent ainsi, et lui amenèrent les cinq rois qu''ils avaient fait sortir de la caverne, le roi de Jérusalem, le roi d''Hébron, le roi de Jarmuth, le roi de Lakis, le roi d''Eglon.
verses.am: እንዲህም አደረጉ፤ አምስቱንም ነገሥታት፥ የኢየሩሳሌምን ንጉሥ የኬብሮንንም ንጉሥ የየርሙትንም ንጉሥ የለኪሶንም ንጉሥ የኦዶላምንም ንጉሥ፥ ከዋሻው ወደ እርሱ አወጡአቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils eurent amené ces rois devant Josué, Josué appela tous les hommes d''Israël, et dit aux chefs des gens de guerre qui avaient marché avec lui: Approchez-vous, mettez vos pieds sur les cous de ces rois. Ils s''approchèrent, et ils mirent les pieds sur leurs cous.
verses.am: እነዚያንም ነገሥታት ወደ ኢያሱ ባወጡአቸው ጊዜ ኢያሱ የእስራኤልን ሰዎች ሁሉ ጠራ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር የሄዱትን የሰልፈኞች አለቆች። ቅረቡ፥ በእነዚህም ነገሥታት አንገት ላይ እግራችሁን አኑሩ አላቸው። ቀረቡም በአንገታቸውም ላይ እግራቸውን አኖሩ።

verses.en: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the Lord do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.
verses.fr: Josué leur dit: Ne craignez point et ne vous effrayez point, fortifiez-vous et ayez du courage, car c''est ainsi que l''Eternel traitera tous vos ennemis contre lesquels vous combattez.
verses.am: ኢያሱም። እግዚአብሔር በምትወጉአቸው በጠላቶቻችሁ ሁሉ ላይ እንዲሁ ያደርጋልና አትፍሩ፥ አትደንግጡ፤ ጽኑ፥ አይዞአችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
verses.fr: Après cela, Josué les frappa et les fit mourir; il les pendit à cinq arbres, et ils restèrent pendus aux arbres jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ መትተው ገደሉአቸው፥ በአምስቱም ዛፎች ላይ ሰቀሉአቸው፤ እስከ ማታም ድረስ በዛፎቹ ተሰቅለው ቈዩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, which remain until this very day.
verses.fr: Vers le coucher du soleil, Josué ordonna qu''on les descendît des arbres, on les jeta dans la caverne où ils s''étaient cachés, et l''on mit à l''entrée de la caverne de grosses pierres, qui y sont demeurées jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: ፀሐይም ልትገባ በቀረበች ጊዜ ኢያሱ አዘዘ፥ ከዛፎችም አወረዱአቸው፥ ተሸሽገውም በነበሩበት ዋሻ ጣሉአቸው፥ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በዋሻው አፍ ታላላቅ ድንጋይ ተደርጎአል።

verses.en: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.fr: Josué prit Makkéda le même jour, et la frappa du tranchant de l''épée; il dévoua par interdit le roi, la ville et tous ceux qui s''y trouvaient; il n''en laissa échapper aucun, et il traita le roi de Makkéda comme il avait traité le roi de Jéricho.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ኢያሱ መቄዳን ያዛት፥ እርስዋንና ንጉሥዋንም በሰይፍ ስለት መታ፤ በእርስዋም ያሉትን ነፍሳት ሁሉ ፈጽሞ አጠፋቸው፥ ከእነርሱም አንዱን ስንኳ አላስቀረም፤ በኢያሪኮም ንጉሥ እንዳደረገ በመቄዳ ንጉሥ አደረገ።

verses.en: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
verses.fr: Josué, et tout Israël avec lui, passa de Makkéda à Libna, et il attaqua Libna.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ ከመቄዳ ወደ ልብና አለፉ፥ ልብናንም ወጉ።

verses.en: And the Lord delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.fr: L''Eternel la livra aussi, avec son roi, entre les mains d''Israël, et la frappa du tranchant de l''épée, elle et tous ceux qui s''y trouvaient; il n''en laissa échapper aucun, et il traita son roi comme il avait traité le roi de Jéricho.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እርስዋንና ንጉሥዋን በእስራኤል እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠ፤ እርስዋንም በእርስዋም ያሉትን ነፍሳት ሁሉ በሰይፍ ስለት መታ፥ በእርስዋም አንዱን ስንኳ አላስቀረም፤ በኢያሪኮም ንጉሥ እንዳደረገው በልብና ንጉሥ አደረገ።

verses.en: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.fr: Josué, et tout Israël avec lui, passa de Libna à Lakis; il campa devant elle, et il l''attaqua.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ ከልብና ወደ ለኪሶ አለፉ፥ ከበቡአትም፥ ወጉአትም።

verses.en: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.fr: L''Eternel livra Lakis entre les mains d''Israël, qui la prit le second jour, et la frappa du tranchant de l''épée, elle et tous ceux qui s''y trouvaient, comme il avait traité Libna.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለኪሶን በእስራኤል እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣት፥ በሁለተኛውም ቀን ያዙአት፤ በልብናም እንዳደረጉት ሁሉ፥ እርስዋን በእርስዋም ያሉትን ነፍሳት ሁሉ በሰይፍ ስለት መቱአቸው።

verses.en: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
verses.fr: Alors Horam, roi de Guézer, monta pour secourir Lakis. Josué le battit, lui et son peuple, sans laisser échapper personne.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም የጌዝር ንጉሥ ሆራም ለኪሶን ለመርዳት ወጣ፤ ኢያሱም አንድ ስንኳ ሳይቀር እርሱንና ሕዝቡን መታ።

verses.en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.fr: Josué, et tout Israël avec lui, passa de Lakis à Eglon; ils campèrent devant elle, et ils l''attaquèrent.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ ከለኪሶ ወደ ኦዶላም አለፉ፥ ከበቡአትም፥ ወጉአትም፤

verses.en: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.fr: Ils la prirent le même jour, et la frappèrent du tranchant de l''épée, elle et tous ceux qui s''y trouvaient; Josué la dévoua par interdit le jour même, comme il avait traité Lakis.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ያዙአት፥ በሰይፍም ስለት መቱአት፤ በለኪሶም እንዳደረገው ሁሉ፥ በእርስዋ ያሉትን ነፍሳት ሁሉ በዚያ ቀን ፈጽሞ አጠፋ።

verses.en: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
verses.fr: Josué, et tout Israël avec lui, monta d''Eglon à Hébron, et ils l''attaquèrent.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ ከኦዶላም ወደ ኬብሮን ወጡ፥ ወጉአትም፥ ያዙአትም፤

verses.en: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.
verses.fr: Ils la prirent, et la frappèrent du tranchant de l''épée, elle, son roi, toutes les villes qui en dépendaient, et tous ceux qui s''y trouvaient; Josué n''en laissa échapper aucun, comme il avait fait à Eglon, et il la dévoua par interdit avec tous ceux qui s''y trouvaient.
verses.am: እርስዋንም ንጉሥዋንም ከተሞችዋንም ሁሉ በእርስዋም ያሉትን ነፍሳት ሁሉ በሰይፍ ስለት መቱ፤ በኦዶላም እንዳደረገው ሁሉ ማንንም አላስቀረም፤ እርስዋንም በእርስዋም ያሉትን ነፍሳት ሁሉ ፈጽሞ አጠፋ።

verses.en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
verses.fr: Josué, et tout Israël avec lui, se dirigea sur Debir, et il l''attaqua.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ ወደ ዳቤር ተመለሱ፥ ወጉአትም፥

verses.en: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
verses.fr: Il la prit, elle, son roi, et toutes les villes qui en dépendaient; ils les frappèrent du tranchant de l''épée, et ils dévouèrent par interdit tous ceux qui s''y trouvaient, sans en laisser échapper aucun; Josué traita Debir et son roi comme il avait traité Hébron et comme il avait traité Libna et son roi.
verses.am: እርስዋንም ንጉሥዋንም ከተሞችዋንም ያዙ፤ በሰይፍም ስለት መቱአቸው፥ በእነርሱም ውስጥ ያሉትን ነፍሳት ሁሉ ፈጽመው አጠፉ፤ ማንንም አላስቀረም፤ በኬብሮን፥ ደግሞ በልብናና በንጉሥዋ እንዳደረገው እንዲሁ በዳቤርና በንጉሥዋ አደረገ።

verses.en: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel commanded.
verses.fr: Josué battit tout le pays, la montagne, le midi, la plaine et les coteaux, et il en battit tous les rois; il ne laissa échapper personne, et il dévoua par interdit tout ce qui respirait, comme l''avait ordonné l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ኢያሱ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ተራራማውን አገር ደቡቡንም ቈላውንም ቍልቍለቱንም ነገሥታቶቻቸውንም ሁሉ መታ፤ ማንንም አላስቀረም፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘውም ነፍስ ያለበትን ሁሉ ፈጽሞ አጠፋ።

verses.en: And Joshua smote them from Kadeshbarnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
verses.fr: Josué les battit de Kadès-Barnéa à Gaza, il battit tout le pays de Gosen jusqu''à Gabaon.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከቃዴስ በርኔ እስከ ጋዛ ድረስ የጎሶምንም ምድር ሁሉ እስከ ገባዖን ድረስ መታ።

verses.en: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.
verses.fr: Josué prit en même temps tous ces rois et leur pays, car l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, combattait pour Israël.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ስለ ተዋጋላቸው ኢያሱ እነዚህን ነገሥታት ሁሉ ምድራቸውንም በአንድ ጊዜ ያዘ።

verses.en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.fr: Et Josué, et tout Israël avec lui, retourna au camp à Guilgal.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ ወደ ሰፈሩ ወደ ጌልገላ ተመለሱ። a

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.fr: Jabin, roi de Hatsor, ayant appris ces choses, envoya des messagers à Jobab, roi de Madon, au roi de Schimron, au roi d''Acschaph,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የአሶር ንጉሥ ኢያቢስ ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ማዶን ንጉሥ ወደ ዮባብ፥ ወደ ሺምሮንም ንጉሥ፥ ወደ አዚፍም ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
verses.fr: aux rois qui étaient au nord dans la montagne, dans la plaine au midi de Kinnéreth, dans la vallée, et sur les hauteurs de Dor à l''occident,
verses.am: በሰሜንም በተራራማው አገር፥ በኪኔሬትም ደቡብ በዓረባ፥ በቈላውም፥ በምዕራብም በኩል ባለ በዶር ኮረብታ ወደ ነበሩ ነገሥታት፥

verses.en: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
verses.fr: aux Cananéens de l''orient et de l''occident, aux Amoréens, aux Héthiens, aux Phéréziens, aux Jébusiens dans la montagne, et aux Héviens au pied de l''Hermon dans le pays de Mitspa.
verses.am: በምሥራቅና በምዕራብም ወዳለው ወደ ከነዓናዊው፥ ወደ አሞራዊውም፥ ወደ ኬጢያዊውም፥ ወደ ፌርዛዊውም፥ በተራራማውም አገር ወዳለው ወደ ኢያቡሳዊው፥ ከአርሞንዔምም በታች በምጽጳ ወዳለው ወደ ኤዊያዊው ላከ።

verses.en: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
verses.fr: Ils sortirent, eux et toutes leurs armées avec eux, formant un peuple innombrable comme le sable qui est sur le bord de la mer, et ayant des chevaux et des chars en très grande quantité.
verses.am: እነዚህም ከሠራዊቶቻቸው ሁሉ ከእጅግም ብዙ ፈረሰኞችና ሠረገሎች ጋር ወጡ፤ በባሕር ዳርም እንዳለ አሸዋ ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
verses.fr: Tous ces rois fixèrent un lieu de réunion, et vinrent camper ensemble près des eaux de Mérom, pour combattre contre Israël.
verses.am: እነዚህም ነገሥታት ሁሉ ተሰብስበው እስራኤልን ለመውጋት መጥተው በማሮን ውኃ አጠገብ አንድ ሆነው ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Josué: Ne les crains point, car demain, à ce moment-ci, je les livrerai tous frappés devant Israël. Tu couperas les jarrets à leurs chevaux, et tu brûleras au feu leurs chars.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን። ነገ በዚህ ጊዜ ሁሉን እንደ ሞቱ አድርጌ በእስራኤል እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁና አትፍራቸው፤ የፈረሶቻቸውንም ቋንጃ ትቈርጣለህ፥ ሰረገሎቻቸውንም በእሳት ታቃጥላለህ አለው።

verses.en: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
verses.fr: Josué, avec tous ses gens de guerre, arriva subitement sur eux près des eaux de Mérom, et ils se précipitèrent au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ከሰልፈኞቹ ሁሉ ጋር በድንገት ወደ ማሮን ውኃ መጣባቸው፥ ወደቀባቸውም።

verses.en: And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephothmaim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
verses.fr: L''Eternel les livra entre les mains d''Israël; ils les battirent et les poursuivirent jusqu''à Sidon la grande, jusqu''à Misrephoth-Maïm, et jusqu''à la vallée de Mitspa vers l''orient; ils les battirent, sans en laisser échapper aucun.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ መቱአቸውም፥ ወደ ታላቂቱም ሲዶና፥ ወደ ማሴሮንም፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ወዳለው ወደ ምጽጳ ሸለቆ አሳደዱአቸው፤ ማንንም ሳያስቀሩ መቱአቸው።

verses.en: And Joshua did unto them as the Lord bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
verses.fr: Josué les traita comme l''Eternel lui avait dit; il coupa les jarrets à leurs chevaux, et il brûla leurs chars au feu.
verses.am: ኢያሱም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው አደረገባቸው፤ የፈረሶቻቸውንም ቋንጃ ቈረጠ፥ ሰረገሎቻቸውንም በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.fr: A son retour, et dans le même temps, Josué prit Hatsor, et frappa son roi avec l''épée: Hatsor était autrefois la principale ville de tous ces royaumes.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ኢያሱ ተመልሶ አሶርን ያዘ፥ ንጉሥዋንም በሰይፍ ገደለ፤ አሶርም አስቀድሞ የእነዚህ መንግሥታት ዋና ከተማ ነበረች።

verses.en: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
verses.fr: On frappa du tranchant de l''épée et l''on dévoua par interdit tous ceux qui s''y trouvaient, il ne resta rien de ce qui respirait, et l''on mit le feu à Hatsor.
verses.am: በእርስዋም ያሉትን ነፍሳት ሁሉ በሰይፍ ስለት ገደሉ፥ ፈጽመውም አጠፉአቸው፤ እስትንፋስ ያለውንም አላስቀሩም፤ አሶርንም በእሳት አቃጠላት።

verses.en: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.
verses.fr: Josué prit aussi toutes les villes de ces rois et tous leurs rois, et il les frappa du tranchant de l''épée, et il les dévoua par interdit, comme l''avait ordonné Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘው፥ ኢያሱ የእነዚህን ነገሥታት ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ ነገሥታቶቻቸውንም ሁሉ ያዘ፥ በሰይፍም ስለት መታቸው፥ ፈጽሞም አጠፋቸው።

verses.en: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
verses.fr: Mais Israël ne brûla aucune des villes situées sur des collines, à l''exception seulement de Hatsor, qui fut brûlée par Josué.
verses.am: እስራኤልም በኮረብቶቹ ላይ የነበሩትን ከተሞች ሁሉ አላቃጠሉም፤ ነገር ግን እስራኤል አሶርን ብቻ አቃጠሉአት።

verses.en: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël gardèrent pour eux tout le butin de ces villes et le bétail; mais ils frappèrent du tranchant de l''épée tous les hommes, jusqu''à ce qu''ils les eussent détruits, sans rien laisser de ce qui respirait.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች የእነዚህን ከተሞች ምርኮ ሁሉ ከብቶቹንም ለራሳቸው ዘረፉ፤ ሰዎቹን ሁሉ ግን እስኪጠፉ ድረስ በሰይፍ ስለት መቱአቸው፥ እስትንፋስ ያለውንም ሁሉ አላስቀሩም።

verses.en: As the Lord commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Josué exécuta les ordres de l''Eternel à Moïse, son serviteur, et de Moïse à Josué; il ne négligea rien de tout ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ባሪያውን ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ ሙሴ ኢያሱን አዝዞት ነበር፥ ኢያሱም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ካዘዘው ሁሉ ምንም አላስቀረም።

verses.en: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que Josué s''empara de tout ce pays, de la montagne, de tout le midi, de tout le pays de Gosen, de la vallée, de la plaine, de la montagne d''Israël et de ses vallées,
verses.am: ኢያሱም ያን ምድር ሁሉ፥ ተራራማውን፥ ደቡቡንም ሁሉ፥ የጎሶምንም ምድር ሁሉ፥ ቈላውንም፥ ዓረባንም፥ የእስራኤልንም ተራራማውንና ቈላውን ያዘ፥

verses.en: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
verses.fr: depuis la montagne nue qui s''élève vers Séir jusqu''à Baal-Gad, dans la vallée du Liban, au pied de la montagne d''Hermon. Il prit tous leurs rois, les frappa et les fit mourir.
verses.am: እስከ ሴይርም ከሚያወጣው ወና ከሆነው ተራራ ጀምሮ ከአርሞንዔም ተራራ በታች በሊባኖስም ሸለቆ ውስጥ እስካለው እስከ በኣልጋድ ድረስ፤ ነገሥታቶቻቸውንም ሁሉ ይዞ መታቸው፥ ገደላቸውም።

verses.en: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.fr: La guerre que soutint Josué contre tous ces rois fut de longue durée.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ብዙ ዘመን ከእነዚህ ነገሥታት ሁሉ ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር።

verses.en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
verses.fr: Il n''y eut aucune ville qui fît la paix avec les enfants d''Israël, excepté Gabaon, habitée par les Héviens; ils les prirent toutes en combattant.
verses.am: በገባዖን ከሚኖሩ ከኤዊያውያን በቀር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር ዕርቅ ያደረገች አንዲት ከተማ አልነበረችም፤ ሁሉን በሰልፍ ያዙ።

verses.en: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel permit que ces peuples s''obstinassent à faire la guerre contre Israël, afin qu''Israël les dévouât par interdit, sans qu''il y eût pour eux de miséricorde, et qu''il les détruisît, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ፥ ያጠፉአቸው ዘንድ ሞገስንም እንዳያገኙ ፈጽመውም እንዲያጠፉአቸው፥ ከእስራኤል ጋር ይጋጠሙ ዘንድ ልባቸውን እንዲያደነድኑ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሆነ።

verses.en: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
verses.fr: Dans le même temps, Josué se mit en marche, et il extermina les Anakim de la montagne d''Hébron, de Debir, d''Anab, de toute la montagne de Juda et de toute la montagne d''Israël; Josué les dévoua par interdit, avec leurs villes.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ኢያሱ መጣ፥ ከተራራማውም አገር ከኬብሮንም ከዳቤርም ከአናብም ከእስራኤልም ተራራማ ሁሉ ከይሁዳም ተራራማ ሁሉ የዔናቅን ልጆች ገደለ፤ ኢያሱም ከከተሞቻቸው ጋር ፈጽሞ አጠፋቸው።

verses.en: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
verses.fr: Il ne resta point d''Anakim dans le pays des enfants d''Israël; il n''en resta qu''à Gaza, à Gath et à Asdod.
verses.am: በጋዛ በጌትም በአዛጦንም ጥቂቶች ቀሩ እንጂ በእስራኤል ልጆች ምድር ከዔናቅ ልጆች ማንም አልቀረም።

verses.en: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
verses.fr: Josué s''empara donc de tout le pays, selon tout ce que l''Eternel avait dit à Moïse. Et Josué le donna en héritage à Israël, à chacun sa portion, d''après leurs tribus. Puis, le pays fut en repos et sans guerre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴ እንደ ነገረው ሁሉ ኢያሱ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ያዘ፤ ኢያሱም ለእስራኤል እንደ ክፍላቸውና እንደ ነገዳቸው ርስት አድርጎ ምድሪቱን ሰጣቸው፤ ምድሪቱም ከሰልፍ ዐረፈች።

verses.en: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
verses.fr: Voici les rois que les enfants d''Israël battirent, et dont ils possédèrent le pays de l''autre côté du Jourdain, vers le soleil levant, depuis le torrent de l''Arnon jusqu''à la montagne de l''Hermon, avec toute la plaine à l''orient.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች የመቱአቸው፥ ከአርኖንም ሸለቆ ጀምሮ እስከ አርሞንዔም ተራራ ድረስ በምሥራቅ ያለውን ዓረባ ሁሉ በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ በፀሐይ መውጫ ያለውን አገራቸውን የወረሱአቸው ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.fr: Sihon, roi des Amoréens, qui habitait à Hesbon. Sa domination s''étendait depuis Aroër, qui est au bord du torrent de l''Arnon, et, depuis le milieu du torrent, sur la moitié de Galaad, jusqu''au torrent de Jabbok, frontière des enfants d''Ammon;
verses.am: በሐሴቦን የተቀመጠው፥ በአርኖንም ሸለቆ አጠገብ ካለችው ከአሮዔር፥ ከሸለቆውም መካከል ጀምሮ የገለዓድን እኩሌታ እስከ ያቦቅ ወንዝ እስከ አሞን ልጆች ዳርቻ ድረስ፥

verses.en: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Bethjeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdothpisgah:
verses.fr: sur la plaine, jusqu''à la mer de Kinnéreth à l''orient, et jusqu''à la mer de la plaine, la mer Salée, à l''orient vers Beth-Jeschimoth; et du côté du midi, sur le pied du Pisga.
verses.am: በምሥራቅም በኩል ያለውን ዓረባ እስከ ኪኔሬት ባሕር ድረስ፥ በቤትየሺሞት መንገድ አጠገብ እስካለው እስከ አረባ ባሕር እስከ ጨው ባሕር ድረስ፥ በደቡብም በኩል ከፈስጋ ተራራ አፋፍ በታች ያለውን ምድር የገዛው የአሞራውያን ንጉሥ ሴዎን፤

verses.en: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.fr: Og, roi de Basan, seul reste des Rephaïm, qui habitait à Aschtaroth et à Edréï.
verses.am: ከራፋይምም ወገን የቀረ፥ በአስታሮትና በኤድራይ የተቀመጠው፥ የአርሞንዔምንም ተራራ፥

verses.en: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.fr: Sa domination s''étendait sur la montagne de l''Hermon, sur Salca, sur tout Basan jusqu''à la frontière des Gueschuriens et des Maacathiens, et sur la moitié de Galaad, frontière de Sihon, roi de Hesbon.
verses.am: ሰልካን፥ ባሳንንም ሁሉ እስከ ጌሹራውያንና እስከ ማዕካታውያን ዳርቻ፥ የገለዓድንም እኩሌታ እስከ ሐሴቦን ንጉሥ እስከ ሴዎን ዳርቻ ድረስ የገዛው የባሳን ንጉሥ ዐግ።

verses.en: Them did Moses the servant of the Lord and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the Lord gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.fr: Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, et les enfants d''Israël, les battirent; et Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, donna leur pays en possession aux Rubénites, aux Gadites, et à la moitié de la tribu de Manassé.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴና የእስራኤል ልጆች መቱአቸው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ ሙሴ ርስት አድርጎ ለሮቤል ልጆች ለጋድም ልጆች ለምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ምድሪቱን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
verses.fr: Voici les rois que Josué et les enfants d''Israël battirent de ce côté-ci du Jourdain, à l''occident, depuis Baal-Gad dans la vallée du Liban jusqu''à la montagne nue qui s''élève vers Séir. Josué donna leur pays en possession aux tribus d''Israël, à chacune sa portion,
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ በምዕራብ በኩል በሊባኖስ ሸለቆ ካለችው ከበኣልጋድ ወደ ሴይር እስከሚያወጣው ወና እስከ ሆነው ተራራ ድረስ ኢያሱ በየክፍላቸው ርስት አድርጎ ለእስራኤል ነገድ በሰጣት ምድር፥ በተራራማው አገር፥ በቈላውም፥ በዓረባም፥ በቍልቍለቱም፥ በምድረ በዳውም፥ በደቡቡም ያሉ ኬጢያውያን አሞራውያንም ከነዓናውያንም ፌርዛውያንም ኤዊያውያንም ኢያቡሳውያንም የሆኑ ኢያሱና የእስራኤል ልጆች የመቱአቸው የምድር ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.en: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
verses.fr: dans la montagne, dans la vallée, dans la plaine, sur les coteaux, dans le désert, et dans le midi; pays des Héthiens, des Amoréens, des Cananéens, des Phéréziens, des Héviens et des Jébusiens.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ በምዕራብ በኩል በሊባኖስ ሸለቆ ካለችው ከበኣልጋድ ወደ ሴይር እስከሚያወጣው ወና እስከ ሆነው ተራራ ድረስ ኢያሱ በየክፍላቸው ርስት አድርጎ ለእስራኤል ነገድ በሰጣት ምድር፥ በተራራማው አገር፥ በቈላውም፥ በዓረባም፥ በቍልቍለቱም፥ በምድረ በዳውም፥ በደቡቡም ያሉ ኬጢያውያን አሞራውያንም ከነዓናውያንም ፌርዛውያንም ኤዊያውያንም ኢያቡሳውያንም የሆኑ ኢያሱና የእስራኤል ልጆች የመቱአቸው የምድር ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.en: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
verses.fr: Le roi de Jéricho, un; le roi d''Aï, près de Béthel, un;
verses.am: የኢያሪኮ ንጉሥ፥ በቤቴል አጠገብ ያለችው የጋይ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Jérusalem, un; le roi d''Hébron, un;
verses.am: የኢየሩሳሌም ንጉሥ፥ የኬብሮን ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Jarmuth, un; le roi de Lakis, un;
verses.am: የየርሙት ንጉሥ፥ የለኪሶ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
verses.fr: le roi d''Eglon, un; le roi de Guézer, un;
verses.am: የጌድር ንጉሥ፥ የሔርማ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Debir, un; le roi de Guéder, un;
verses.am: የጌድር ንጉሥ፥ የሔርማ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Horma, un; le roi d''Arad, un;
verses.am: የዓራድ ንጉሥ፥ የልብና ንጉሥ፥ የዓዶላም ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Libna, un; le roi d''Adullam, un;
verses.am: የመቄዳ ንጉሥ፥ የቤቴል ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Makkéda, un; le roi de Béthel, un;
verses.am: የለሸሮን ንጉሥ፥ የማዶን ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Tappuach, un; le roi de Hépher, un;
verses.am: የለሸሮን ንጉሥ፥ የማዶን ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
verses.fr: le roi d''Aphek, un; le roi de Lascharon, un;
verses.am: የአሶር ንጉሥ፥ የሺምሮን ሚሮን ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Madon, un; le roi de Hatsor, un;
verses.am: የአዚፍ ንጉሥ፥ የታዕናክ ንጉሥ፥ የመጊዶ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Shimronmeron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Schimron-Meron, un; le roi d''Acschaph, un;
verses.am: የቃዴስ ንጉሥ፥ በቀርሜሎስ የነበረ የዮቅንዓም ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Taanac, un; le roi de Meguiddo, un;
verses.am: በዶር ኮረብታ የነበረ የዶር ንጉሥ፥ የጌልገላ አሕዛብ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Kédesch, un; le roi de Jokneam, au Carmel, un;
verses.am: የቲርሳ ንጉሥ፥ ነገሥታቱ ሁሉ ሠላሳ አንድ ናቸው። a

verses.en: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
verses.fr: le roi de Dor, sur les hauteurs de Dor, un; le roi de Gojim, près de Guilgal, un;
verses.am: ፤ በዶር ኮረብታ የነበረ የዶር ንጉሥ፥ የጌልገላ አሕዛብ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
verses.fr: le roi de Thirtsa, un. Total des rois: trente et un.
verses.am: ፤ የቲርሳ ንጉሥ፥ ነገሥታቱ ሁሉ ሠላሳ አንድ ናቸው።

verses.en: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the Lord said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
verses.fr: Josué était vieux, avancé en âge. L''Eternel lui dit alors: Tu es devenu vieux, tu es avancé en âge, et le pays qui te reste à soumettre est très grand.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ሸመገለ በዕድሜም አረጀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አለው። አንተ ሸመገልህ፥ በዕድሜህም አረጀህ፤ ያልተወረሰች እጅግ ብዙ ምድር ገና ቀርታለች፤

verses.en: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
verses.fr: Voici le pays qui reste: tous les districts des Philistins et tout le territoire des Gueschuriens,
verses.am: የቀረችውም ምድር ይህች ናት፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንና የጌሹራውያን አገር ሁሉ፥

verses.en: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
verses.fr: depuis le Schichor qui coule devant l''Egypte jusqu''à la frontière d''Ekron au nord, contrée qui doit être tenue pour cananéenne, et qui est occupée par les cinq princes des Philistins, celui de Gaza, celui d''Asdod, celui d''Askalon, celui de Gath et celui d''Ekron, et par les Avviens;
verses.am: በግብፅ ፊት ካለው ከሺሖር ወንዝ ጀምሮ በሰሜን በኩል እስካለችው የከነዓናውያን ሆና እስከ ተቈጠረችው እስከ አቃሮን ዳርቻ ድረስ፥ የጋዛ፥ የአዛጦን፥ የአስቀሎና፥ የጌት፥ የአቃሮን፥ አምስቱ የፍልስጥኤማውያን መኳንንት፥

verses.en: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
verses.fr: partir du midi, tout le pays des Cananéens, et Meara qui est aux Sidoniens, jusqu''à Aphek, jusqu''à la frontière des Amoréens;
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል የኤዋውያን፥ የከነዓናውያን ምድር ሁሉ፥ ለሲዶናውያንም የምትሆን መዓራ እስከ አሞራውያን ዳርቻ እስከ አፌቅ ድረስ፥

verses.en: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baalgad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
verses.fr: le pays des Guibliens, et tout le Liban vers le soleil levant, depuis Baal-Gad au pied de la montagne d''Hermon jusqu''à l''entrée de Hamath;
verses.am: የጌባላውያውንም ምድር፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ከአርሞንዔም ተራራ በታች ካለችው በኣልጋድ ጀምሮ እስከ ሐማት መግቢያ ድረስ ያለችው ሊባኖስ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephothmaim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.fr: tous les habitants de la montagne, depuis le Liban jusqu''à Misrephoth-Maïm, tous les Sidoniens. Je les chasserai devant les enfants d''Israël. Donne seulement ce pays en héritage par le sort à Israël, comme je te l''ai prescrit;
verses.am: በተራራማውም አገር የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ከሊባኖስ ጀምሮ እስከ ማሴሮን ድረስ ሲዶናውያን ሁሉ፤ እነዚህን ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት አባርራቸዋለሁ፤ እንዳዘዝሁህም ምድራቸውን ለእስራኤል ርስት አድርገህ አካፍላቸው።

verses.en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.fr: et divise maintenant ce pays par portions entre les neuf tribus et la demi-tribu de Manassé.
verses.am: አሁንም ይህን ምድር ለዘጠኙ ነገድ ለምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስት አድርገህ ክፈለው።

verses.en: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the Lord gave them;
verses.fr: Les Rubénites et les Gadites, avec l''autre moitié de la tribu de Manassé, ont reçu leur héritage, que Moïse leur a donné de l''autre côté du Jourdain, à l''orient, comme le leur a donné Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ እንደ ሰጣቸው ከእርሱ ከምናሴ ጋር የሮቤልና የጋድ ልጆች በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሙሴ የሰጣቸውን ርስታቸውን ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
verses.fr: depuis Aroër sur les bords du torrent de l''Arnon, et depuis la ville qui est au milieu de la vallée, toute la plaine de Médeba, jusqu''à Dibon;
verses.am: በአርኖን ሸለቆ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር፥ በሸለቆውም መካከል ካለችው ከተማ ጀምሮ የሜድባን ሜዳ ሁሉ እስከ ዲቦን ድረስ፥

verses.en: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.fr: toutes les villes de Sihon, roi des Amoréens, qui régnait à Hesbon, jusqu''à la frontière des enfants d''Ammon;
verses.am: በሐሴቦንም የነገሠ የአሞራውያን ንጉሥ የሴዎን ከተሞች ሁሉ እስከ አሞን ልጆች ዳርቻ ድረስ፥

verses.en: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
verses.fr: Galaad, le territoire des Gueschuriens et des Maacathiens, toute la montagne d''Hermon, et tout Basan, jusqu''à Salca;
verses.am: ገለዓድንም፥ የጌሹራውያንንና የማዕካታውያንን ዳርቻ ሁሉ፥ የአርሞንዔምንም ተራራ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
verses.fr: tout le royaume d''Og en Basan, qui régnait à Aschtaroth et à Edréï, et qui était le seul reste des Rephaïm. Moïse battit ces rois, et les chassa.
verses.am: ባሳንንም ሁሉ እስከ ሰልካ ድረስ፥ በባሳን የነበረውን በአስታሮትና በኤድራይ የነገሠውን የዐግን መንግሥት ሁሉ፤ እርሱም ከራፋይም የቀረ ነበረ፤ እነዚህንም ሙሴ መታቸው አወጣቸውም።

verses.en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
verses.fr: Mais les enfants d''Israël ne chassèrent point les Gueschuriens et les Maacathiens, qui ont habité au milieu d''Israël jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን ጌሹራውያንንና ማዕካታውያንን አላወጡም፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ጌሹርና ማዕካት በእስራኤል መካከል ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: Only unto the tribes of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the Lord God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.fr: La tribu de Lévi fut la seule à laquelle Moïse ne donna point d''héritage; les sacrifices consumés par le feu devant l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, tel fut son héritage, comme il le lui avait dit.
verses.am: ለሌዊ ነገድ ግን ርስት አልሰጠም፤ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር የቀረበው በእሳት የተደረገ መሥዋዕት ርስታቸው ነው፥ እርሱ እንደ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
verses.fr: Moïse avait donné à la tribu des fils de Ruben une part selon leurs familles.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለሮቤል ልጆች ነገድ በየወገናቸው ርስትን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.fr: Ils eurent pour territoire, à partir d''Aroër sur les bords du torrent d''Arnon, et de la ville qui est au milieu de la vallée, toute la plaine près de Médeba,
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም በአርኖን ሸለቆ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ በሸለቆው መካከል ያለችው ከተማ፥ የሜድባ ሜዳ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Bethbaalmeon,
verses.fr: Hesbon et toutes ses villes dans la plaine, Dibon, Bamoth-Baal, Beth-Baal-Meon,
verses.am: ሐሴቦንም፥ በሜዳውም ያሉት ከተሞችዋ ሁሉ፥ ዲቦን፥ ባሞትበኣል፥

verses.en: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.fr: Jahats, Kedémoth, Méphaath,
verses.am: ቤትበኣልምዖን፥ ያሀጽ፥ ቅዴሞት፥

verses.en: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.fr: Kirjathaïm, Sibma, Tséreth-Haschachar sur la montagne de la vallée,
verses.am: ሜፍዓት፥ ቂርያታይም፥ ሴባማ፥ በሸለቆውም ተራራ ያለችው ጼሬትሻሐር፥

verses.en: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,
verses.fr: Beth-Peor, les coteaux du Pisga, Beth-Jeschimoth,
verses.am: ቤተ ፌጎር፥ ከፈስጋ ተራራ በታች ያለው ምድር፥ ቤትየሺሞት፥

verses.en: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
verses.fr: toutes les villes de la plaine, et tout le royaume de Sihon, roi des Amoréens, qui régnait à Hesbon: Moïse l''avait battu, lui et les princes de Madian, Evi, Rékem, Tsur, Hur et Réba, princes qui relevaient de Sihon et qui habitaient dans le pays.
verses.am: የሜዳውም ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ በሐሴቦንም የነገሠው የአሞራውያን ንጉሥ የሴዎን መንግሥት ሁሉ ነበረ፤ ሙሴም እርሱንና በምድሪቱ የተቀመጡትን የሴዎንን መሳፍንት፥ የምድያምን አለቆች ኤዊን፥ ሮቆምን፥ ሱርን፥ ሑርን፥ ሪባን መታቸው።

verses.en: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
verses.fr: Parmi ceux que tuèrent les enfants d''Israël, ils avaient aussi fait périr avec l''épée le devin Balaam, fils de Beor.
verses.am: ከገደሉአቸውም ሰዎች ጋር የእስራኤል ልጆች ምዋርተኛውን የቢዖርን ልጅ በለዓምን በሰይፍ ገደሉት።

verses.en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.fr: Le Jourdain servait de limite au territoire des fils de Ruben. Voilà l''héritage des fils de Ruben selon leurs familles; les villes et leurs villages.
verses.am: የሮቤልም ልጆች ድንበር የዮርዳኖስ ወንዝና ዳርቻው ነበረ። የሮቤል ልጆች ርስት ከተሞቻቸውም መንደሮቻቸውም በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
verses.fr: Moïse avait donné à la tribu de Gad, aux fils de Gad, une part selon leurs familles.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለጋድ ነገድ ለጋድም ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ርስት አድርጎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.fr: Ils eurent pour territoire Jaezer, toutes les villes de Galaad, la moitié du pays des enfants d''Ammon jusqu''à Aroër vis-à-vis de Rabba,
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ኢያዜርና የገለዓድ ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የአሞንም ልጆች ምድር እኩሌታ በረባት ፊት እስካለችው እስከ አሮዔር ድረስ፥

verses.en: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
verses.fr: depuis Hesbon jusqu''à Ramath-Mitspé et Bethonim, depuis Mahanaïm jusqu''à la frontière de Debir,
verses.am: ከሐሴቦን ጀምሮ እስከ ራማት ምጽጴ፥ እስከ ብጦኒም ድረስ፥ ከመሃናይም ጀምሮ እስከ ዳቤር ዳርቻ ድረስ፥

verses.en: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
verses.fr: et, dans la vallée, Beth-Haram, Beth-Nimra, Succoth et Tsaphon, reste du royaume de Sihon, roi de Hesbon, ayant le Jourdain pour limite jusqu''à l''extrémité de la mer de Kinnéreth de l''autre côté du Jourdain, à l''orient.
verses.am: በሸለቆውም ቤትሀራም፥ ቤትኒምራ፥ ሱኮት፥ ጻፎን፥ የሐሴቦን ንጉሥ የሴዎን መንግሥት ቅሬታ ነበረ። ድንበሩም ዮርዳኖስና በምሥራቅ በኩል ባለው በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ የኪኔሬት ባሕር ወዲያኛው ዳርቻ ነበር።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
verses.fr: Voilà l''héritage des fils de Gad selon leurs familles; les villes et leurs villages.
verses.am: የጋድ ልጆች ርስት ከተሞቻቸውም መንደሮቻቸውም በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
verses.fr: Moïse avait donné à la demi-tribu de Manassé, aux fils de Manassé, une part selon leurs familles.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስት ሰጣቸው፤ ለምናሴም ልጆች ነገድ እኩሌታ በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
verses.fr: Ils eurent pour territoire, à partir de Mahanaïm, tout Basan, tout le royaume d''Og, roi de Basan, et tous les bourgs de Jaïr en Basan, soixante villes.
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ከመሃናይም ጀምሮ የባሳን ንጉሥ የዐግ መንግሥት፥ ባሳን ሁሉ፥ በባሳንም ያሉት የኢያዕር መንደሮች ሁሉ ስድሳው ከተሞች፥ የገለዓድም እኩሌታ፥

verses.en: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
verses.fr: La moitié de Galaad, Aschtaroth et Edréï, villes du royaume d''Og en Basan, échurent aux fils de Makir, fils de Manassé, à la moitié des fils de Makir, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: በባሳንም ያሉት የዐግ መንግሥት ከተሞች፥ አስታሮትና ኤድራይ ነበረ። እነዚህም ለምናሴ ልጅ ለማኪር ልጆች ሆኑ፤ ለማኪር ልጆች እኩሌታ በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
verses.fr: Telles sont les parts que fit Moïse, lorsqu''il était dans les plaines de Moab, de l''autre côté du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho, à l''orient.
verses.am: ሙሴ በምሥራቅ በኩል በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ሳለ የከፈለው ርስት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the Lord God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.fr: Moïse ne donna point d''héritage à la tribu de Lévi; l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, tel fut son héritage, comme il le lui avait dit.
verses.am: ለሌዊ ነገድ ግን ሙሴ ርስት አልሰጠም፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዳላቸው ርስታቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.
verses.fr: Voici ce que les enfants d''Israël reçurent en héritage dans le pays de Canaan, ce que partagèrent entre eux le sacrificateur Eléazar, Josué, fils de Nun, et les chefs de famille des tribus des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በከነዓን ምድር የወረሱት፥ ካህኑ አልዓዛርና የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ነገድ የአባቶቻቸው አለቆች ያካፈሉአቸው ርስት ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: By lot was their inheritance, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
verses.fr: Le partage eut lieu d''après le sort, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné par Moïse, pour les neuf tribus et pour la demi-tribu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ ለዘጠኙ ነገድና ለእኩሌታው በየርስታቸው በዕጣ አካፈሉአቸው።

verses.en: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
verses.fr: Car Moïse avait donné un héritage aux deux tribus et à la demi-tribu de l''autre côté du Jourdain; mais il n''avait point donné aux Lévites d''héritage parmi eux.
verses.am: ለሁለቱ ነገድና ለእኩሌታው ነገድ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሙሴ ርስት ሰጥቶ ነበረ፤ ነገር ግን በመካከላቸው ለሌዋውያን ርስት አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.en: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
verses.fr: Les fils de Joseph formaient deux tribus, Manassé et Ephraïm; et l''on ne donna point de part aux Lévites dans le pays, si ce n''est des villes pour habitation, et les banlieues pour leurs troupeaux et pour leurs biens.
verses.am: የዮሴፍ ልጆች ምናሴና ኤፍሬም ሁለት ነገዶች ነበሩ፤ ለሌዋውያንም ከሚቀመጡባቸው ከተሞች ለእንስሶቻቸውና ለከብቶቻቸውም ከሚሆን መሰምርያቸው በቀር በምድሩ ውስጥ ድርሻ አልሰጡአቸውም።

verses.en: As the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël se conformèrent aux ordres que l''Eternel avait donnés à Moïse, et ils partagèrent le pays.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች አደረጉ፥ ምድሪቱንም ተካፈሉ።

verses.en: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the Lord said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.
verses.fr: Les fils de Juda s''approchèrent de Josué, à Guilgal; et Caleb, fils de Jephunné, le Kenizien, lui dit: Tu sais ce que l''Eternel a déclaré à Moïse, homme de Dieu, au sujet de moi et au sujet de toi, à Kadès-Barnéa.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ልጆች በጌልገላ ወደ ኢያሱ ቀረቡ፤ ቄኔዛዊውም የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ አለው። ለአምላክህ ሰው ለሙሴ ስለ እኔና ስለ አንተ እግዚአብሔር በቃዴስ በርኔ የተናገረውን ነገር ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
verses.fr: J''étais âgé de quarante ans lorsque Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, m''envoya de Kadès-Barnéa pour explorer le pays, et je lui fis un rapport avec droiture de coeur.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ምድርን እሰልል ዘንድ ከቃዴስ በርኔ በላከኝ ጊዜ እኔ የአርባ ዓመት ሰው ነበርሁ እኔም በልቤ የነበረውን ቃል መለስሁለት።

verses.en: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.fr: Mes frères qui étaient montés avec moi découragèrent le peuple, mais moi je suivis pleinement la voie de l''Eternel, mon Dieu.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር የወጡ ወንድሞቼ ግን የሕዝቡን ልብ አቀለጡ፤ እኔ ግን አምላኬን እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽሜ ተከተልሁ።

verses.en: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.fr: Et ce jour-là Moïse jura, en disant: Le pays que ton pied a foulé sera ton héritage à perpétuité, pour toi et pour tes enfants, parce que tu as pleinement suivi la voie de l''Eternel, mon Dieu.
verses.am: ሙሴም በዚያ ቀን። አምላኬን እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽመህ ተከትለሃልና እግርህ የረገጠው ምድር ለአንተና ለልጆችህ ለዘላለም በእርግጥ ርስት ይሆናል ብሎ ማለ።

verses.en: And now, behold, the Lord hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the Lord spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
verses.fr: Maintenant voici, l''Eternel m''a fait vivre, comme il l''a dit. Il y a quarante-cinq ans que l''Eternel parlait ainsi à Moïse, lorsqu''Israël marchait dans le désert; et maintenant voici, je suis âgé aujourd''hui de quatre-vingt-cinq ans.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ ይህን ቃል ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ እስራኤል በምድረ በዳ ሲዞሩ፥ እርሱ እንደ ተናገረኝ እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን አርባ አምስት ዓመት በሕይወት አኖረኝ፤ አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ለእኔ ዛሬ ሰማንያ አምስት ዓመት ሆነኝ።

verses.en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
verses.fr: Je suis encore vigoureux comme au jour où Moïse m''envoya; j''ai autant de force que j''en avais alors, soit pour combattre, soit pour sortir et pour entrer.
verses.am: ሙሴም በላከኝ ጊዜ እንደ ነበርሁ፥ ዛሬ ጕልበታም ነኝ፤ ጕልበቴም በዚያን ጊዜ እንደ ነበረ፥ እንዲሁ ዛሬ ለመዋጋት ለመውጣትም ለመግባትም ጉልበቴ ያው ነው።

verses.en: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the Lord spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the Lord will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the Lord said.
verses.fr: Donne-moi donc cette montagne dont l''Eternel a parlé dans ce temps-là; car tu as appris alors qu''il s''y trouve des Anakim, et qu''il y a des villes grandes et fortifiées. L''Eternel sera peut-être avec moi, et je les chasserai, comme l''Eternel a dit.
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ በዚያን ቀን እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ይህን ተራራማ አገር ስጠኝ፤ አንተ በዚያ ቀን ዔናቃውያን ታላላቆችና የተመሸጉ ከተሞችም በዚያ እንዳሉ ሰምተህ ነበር፤ ምናልባት እግዚአብሔር ከእኔ ጋር ይሆናል፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረኝ አሳድዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
verses.fr: Josué bénit Caleb, fils de Jephunné, et il lui donna Hébron pour héritage.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ባረከው፤ ለዮፎኒም ልጅ ለካሌብ ኬብሮንን ርስት አድርጎ ሰጠው።

verses.en: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que Caleb, fils de Jephunné, le Kenizien, a eu jusqu''à ce jour Hébron pour héritage, parce qu''il avait pleinement suivi la voie de l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽሞ ስለ ተከተለ ኬብሮን እስከ ዛሬ ለቄኔዛዊው ለዮፎኒ ልጅ ለካሌብ ርስት ሆነች።

verses.en: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
verses.fr: Hébron s''appelait autrefois Kirjath-Arba: Arba avait été l''homme le plus grand parmi les Anakim. Le pays fut dès lors en repos et sans guerre.
verses.am: የኬብሮንም ስም አስቀድሞ ቂርያትአርባቅ ትባል ነበር፤ ይህም አርባቅ በዔናቅ ሰዎች መካከል ከሁሉ ከፍ ያለ ነበረ። ምድሪቱም ከውጊያ ዐረፈች። a

verses.en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
verses.fr: La part échue par le sort à la tribu des fils de Juda, selon leurs familles, s''étendait vers la frontière d''Edom, jusqu''au désert de Tsin, au midi, à l''extrémité méridionale.
verses.am: ለይሁዳም ልጆች ነገድ በየወገናቸው እስከ ጺን ምድረ በዳ እስከ ደቡብ መጨረሻ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ዳርቻ ድረስ ዕጣ ሆነላቸው።

verses.en: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
verses.fr: Ainsi, leur limite méridionale partait de l''extrémité de la mer Salée, de la langue qui fait face au sud.
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል ያለው ድንበራቸው እስከ ጨው ባሕር መጨረሻ ወደ ደቡብ እስከሚያይ እስከ ባሕር ልሳን ነበረ።

verses.en: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
verses.fr: Elle se prolongeait au midi de la montée d''Akrabbim, passait par Tsin, et montait au midi de Kadès-Barnéa; elle passait de là par Hetsron, montait vers Addar, et tournait à Karkaa;
verses.am: ከዚያም በአቅረቢም ዐቀበት በደቡብ በኩል ወጣ፥ ወደ ጺንም አለፈ፥ በቃዴስ በርኔ ወደ ደቡብ በኩል ወጣ፥ በሐጽሮንም በኩል አለፈ፥ ወደ አዳርም ወጣ፥

verses.en: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
verses.fr: elle passait ensuite par Atsmon, et continuait jusqu''au torrent d''Egypte, pour aboutir à la mer. Ce sera votre limite au midi.
verses.am: ወደ ቀርቃ ዞረ፥ ወደ አጽሞንም አለፈ፥ በግብፅም ወንዝ በኩል ወጣ፥ የድንበሩም መውጫ በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ፤ በደቡብ በኩል ያለው ድንበራቸው ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
verses.fr: La limite orientale était la mer Salée jusqu''à l''embouchure du Jourdain. La limite septentrionale partait de la langue de mer qui est à l''embouchure du Jourdain.
verses.am: በምሥራቅም በኩል ያለው ድንበር እስከ ጨው ባሕር እስከ ዮርዳኖስም መጨረሻ ነበረ። በሰሜንም በኩል ያለው ድንበር በዮርዳኖስ መጨረሻ እስካለው እስከ ባሕሩ ልሳን ድረስ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
verses.fr: Elle montait vers Beth-Hogla, passait au nord de Beth-Araba, et s''élevait jusqu''à la pierre de Bohan, fils de Ruben;
verses.am: ከዚያም ድንበሩ ወደ ቤትሖግላ ወጣ፥ በቤትዓረባ በሰሜን በኩል አለፈ፥ ወደ ሮቤልም ልጅ ወደ ቦሀን ድንጋይ ወጣ፤

verses.en: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the goings out thereof were at Enrogel:
verses.fr: elle montait à Debir, à quelque distance de la vallée d''Acor, et se dirigeait vers le nord du côté de Guilgal, qui est vis-à-vis de la montée d''Adummim au sud du torrent. Elle passait près des eaux d''En-Schémesch, et se prolongeait jusqu''à En-Roguel.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ከአኮር ሸለቆ ወደ ዳቤር ወጣ፥ በሰሜን በኩል በአዱሚም ዐቀበት ፊት ለፊት፥ በወንዙ በደቡብ በኩል ወዳለችው ወደ ጌልገላ ተመለከተ፤ ድንበሩም ወደ ቤት ሳሚስ ውኃ አለፈ፥ መውጫውም በዓይንሮጌል አጠገብ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
verses.fr: Elle montait de là par la vallée de Ben- Hinnom au côté méridional de Jebus, qui est Jérusalem, puis s''élevait jusqu''au sommet de la montagne, qui est devant la vallée de Hinnom à l''occident, et à l''extrémité de la vallée des Rephaïm au nord
verses.am: ድንበሩም በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ አጠገብ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደምትባለው ወደ ኢያቡሳዊው ወደ ደቡብ ወገን ወጣ፤ ድንበሩም በራፋይም ሸለቆ ዳር በሰሜን በኩል ባለው በሄኖም ሸለቆ ፊት ለፊት በምዕራብ ወገን ወዳለው ተራራ ራስ ላይ ወጣ፤

verses.en: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:
verses.fr: Du sommet de la montagne elle s''étendait jusqu''à la source des eaux de Nephthoach, continuait vers les villes de la montagne d''Ephron, et se prolongeait par Baala, qui est Kirjath-Jearim.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ከተራራው ራስ ወደ ኔፍቶ ውኃ ምንጭ ደረሰ፥ ወደ ዔፍሮንም ተራራ ከተሞች ወጣ፤ ቂርያትይዓሪም ወደምትባል ወደ በኣላ ደረሰ።

verses.en: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
verses.fr: De Baala elle tournait à l''occident vers la montagne de Séir, traversait le côté septentrional de la montagne de Jearim, à Kesalon, descendait à Beth-Schémesch, et passait par Thimna.
