verses.am: ድንበሩም ከበኣላ በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ሴይር ተራራ ዞረ፤ ክሳሎን ወደምትባል ወደ ይዓሪም ተራራ ወገን በሰሜን በኩል አለፈ፤ ወደ ቤትሳሚስ ወረደ፥ በተምና በኩልም አለፈ።

verses.en: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.fr: Elle continuait sur le côté septentrional d''Ekron, s''étendait vers Schicron, passait par la montagne de Baala, et se prolongeait jusqu''à Jabneel, pour aboutir à la mer.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ አቃሮን ወደ ሰሜን ወገን ወጣ፤ ወደ ሽክሮን ደረሰ፤ ወደ በኣላ ተራራ አለፈ፥ በየብኒኤል በኩልም ወጣ፤ የድንበሩም መውጫ በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
verses.fr: La limite occidentale était la grande mer. Telles furent de tous les côtés les limites des fils de Juda, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: በምዕራቡም በኩል ያለው ድንበር እስከ ታላቁ ባሕርና እስከ ዳርቻው ድረስ ነበረ። ለይሁዳ ልጆች በየወገናቸው በዙሪያው ያለ ድንበራቸው ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
verses.fr: On donna à Caleb, fils de Jephunné, une part au milieu des fils de Juda, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Josué; on lui donna Kirjath-Arba, qui est Hébron: Arba était le père d''Anak.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን እንዳዘዘው ለዮፎኒ ልጅ ለካሌብ በይሁዳ ልጆች መካከል ቂርያትአርባቅ የምትባለውን ከተማ ድርሻ አድርጎ ሰጠው፤ እርስዋም ኬብሮን ናት፥ ይህም አርባቅ የዔናቅ አባት ነበረ።

verses.en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.fr: Caleb en chassa les trois fils d''Anak: Schéschaï, Ahiman et Talmaï, enfants d''Anak.
verses.am: ካሌብም ሦስቱን የዔናቅን ልጆች ሴሲንና አኪመንን ተላሚንም ከዚያ አሳደደ።

verses.en: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.
verses.fr: De là il monta contre les habitants de Debir: Debir s''appelait autrefois Kirjath-Sépher.
verses.am: ከዚያም በዳቤር ሰዎች ላይ ወጣ፤ የዳቤርም ስም አስቀድሞ ቂርያትሤፍር ትባል ነበር።

verses.en: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.fr: Caleb dit: Je donnerai ma fille Acsa pour femme à celui qui battra Kirjath-Sépher et qui la prendra.
verses.am: ካሌብም። ቂርያትሤፍርን ለሚመታ ለሚይዛትም ልጄን ዓክሳን አጋባዋለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.fr: Othniel, fils de Kenaz, frère de Caleb, s''en empara; et Caleb lui donna pour femme sa fille Acsa.
verses.am: የካሌብ ወንድም የቄኔዝ ልጅ ጎቶንያል ያዛት፤ ልጁንም ዓክሳን አጋባው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
verses.fr: Lorsqu''elle fut entrée chez Othniel, elle le sollicita de demander à son père un champ. Elle descendit de dessus son âne, et Caleb lui dit: Qu''as-tu?
verses.am: እርስዋም ወደ እርሱ በመጣች ጊዜ ከአባትዋ እርሻ እንዲለምን መከረችው፤ እርስዋም ከአህያዋ ወረደች፤

verses.en: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
verses.fr: Elle répondit: Fais-moi un présent, car tu m''as donné une terre du midi; donne-moi aussi des sources d''eau. Et il lui donna les sources supérieures et les sources inférieures.
verses.am: ካሌብም። ምን ፈለግሽ? አላት። እርስዋም። በረከትን ስጠኝ፤ በደቡብ በኩል ያለውን ምድር ሰጥተኸኛልና አሁን ደግሞ የውኃውን ምንጭ ስጠኝ አለችው። እርሱም የላይኛውንና የታችኛውን ምንጭ ሰጣት።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.fr: Tel fut l''héritage des fils de Juda, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: በየወገኖቻቸውም የይሁዳ ልጆች ነገድ ርስት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
verses.fr: Les villes situées dans la contrée du midi, à l''extrémité de la tribu des fils de Juda, vers la frontière d''Edom, étaient: Kabtseel, Eder, Jagur,
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል በምድራቸው ዳርቻ አጠገብ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ድንበር ያሉት የይሁዳ ልጆች ነገድ ከተሞች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
verses.fr: Kina, Dimona, Adada,
verses.am: ቀብስኤል፥ ዔዴር፥ ያጉር፥ ቂና፥

verses.en: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
verses.fr: Kédesch, Hatsor, Ithnan,
verses.am: ዲሞና፥ ዓድዓዳ፥ ቃዴስ፥ ሐጾር፥ ዪትናን፥

verses.en: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
verses.fr: Ziph, Thélem, Bealoth,
verses.am: ቤትጳሌጥ፥ ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ቤርሳቤህ፥ ቢዝዮትያ፥

verses.en: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
verses.fr: Hatsor-Hadattha, Kerijoth-Hetsron, qui est Hatsor,
verses.am: ቤትጳሌጥ፥ ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ቤርሳቤህ፥ ቢዝዮትያ፥

verses.en: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
verses.fr: Amam, Schema, Molada,
verses.am: ቤትጳሌጥ፥ ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ቤርሳቤህ፥ ቢዝዮትያ፥

verses.en: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,
verses.fr: Hatsar-Gadda, Heschmon, Beth-Paleth,
verses.am: ኪሲል፥ ሔርማ፥ ጺቅላግ፥ ማድማና፥ ሳንሳና፥

verses.en: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
verses.fr: Hatsar-Schual, Beer-Schéba, Bizjothja,
verses.am: ኪሲል፥ ሔርማ፥ ጺቅላግ፥ ማድማና፥ ሳንሳና፥

verses.en: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
verses.fr: Baala, Ijjim, Atsem,
verses.am: ልባዎት፥ ሺልሂም፥ ዓይን፥ ሪሞን፤ ሀያዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
verses.fr: Eltholad, Kesil, Horma,
verses.am: ዓይንገኒም፥ ታጱዋ፥ ዓይናም፥ የርሙት፥

verses.en: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
verses.fr: Tsiklag, Madmanna, Sansanna,
verses.am: ዓይንገኒም፥ ታጱዋ፥ ዓይናም፥ የርሙት፥

verses.en: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
verses.fr: Lebaoth, Schilhim, Aïn, et Rimmon. Total des villes: vingt-neuf, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ዓዶላም፥ ሰኰት፥ ዓዜቃ፥ ሽዓራይም፥ ዓዲታይም፥ ግዴራ፥ ግዴሮታይም፤ አሥራ አራት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
verses.fr: Dans la plaine: Eschthaol, Tsorea, Aschna,
verses.am: ምጽጳ፥ ዮቅትኤል፥ ለኪሶ፥ ቦጽቃት፥

verses.en: And Zanoah, and Engannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
verses.fr: Zanoach, En-Gannim, Tappuach, Enam,
verses.am: ምጽጳ፥ ዮቅትኤል፥ ለኪሶ፥ ቦጽቃት፥

verses.en: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
verses.fr: Jarmuth, Adullam, Soco, Azéka,
verses.am: ንጺብ፥ ቅዒላ፥ አክዚብ፥ መሪሳ፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
verses.fr: Schaaraïm, Adithaïm, Guedéra, et Guedérothaïm; quatorze villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ንጺብ፥ ቅዒላ፥ አክዚብ፥ መሪሳ፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
verses.fr: Tsenan, Hadascha, Migdal-Gad,
verses.am: ንጺብ፥ ቅዒላ፥ አክዚብ፥ መሪሳ፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
verses.fr: Dilean, Mitspé, Joktheel,
verses.am: አቃሮን ከተመሸጉና ካልተመሸጉ መንደሮችዋ ጋር፤

verses.en: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
verses.fr: Lakis, Botskath, Eglon,
verses.am: ከአቃሮንም ጀምሮ እስከ ባሕር ድረስ በአዛጦን አጠገብ ያሉት ሁሉ ከመንደሮቻቸው ጋር።

verses.en: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
verses.fr: Cabbon, Lachmas, Kithlisch,
verses.am: አዛጦንና የተመሸጉና ያልተመሸጉ መንደሮችዋም፥ ጋዛና የተመሸጉ ያልተመሸጉም መንደሮችዋ፥ እስከ ግብፅ ወንዝና እስከ ታላቁ ባሕር ዳርቻ ድረስ።

verses.en: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
verses.fr: Guedéroth, Beth-Dagon, Naama, et Makkéda; seize villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: በተራራማውም አገር ሳምር፥ የቲር፥

verses.en: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
verses.fr: Libna, Ether, Aschan,
verses.am: ሶኮ፥ ደና፥ ዳቤር የምትባለው ቂርያትሰና፥

verses.en: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
verses.fr: Jiphtach, Aschna, Netsib,
verses.am: አፌቃ፥ ሑምጣ፥ ኬብሮን የምትባል ቂርያትአርባቅ፥ ጺዖር፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
verses.fr: Keïla, Aczib, et Maréscha; neuf villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: አፌቃ፥ ሑምጣ፥ ኬብሮን የምትባል ቂርያትአርባቅ፥ ጺዖር፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
verses.fr: Ekron, les villes de son ressort et ses villages;
verses.am: አፌቃ፥ ሑምጣ፥ ኬብሮን የምትባል ቂርያትአርባቅ፥ ጺዖር፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
verses.fr: depuis Ekron et à l''occident, toutes les villes près d''Asdod, et leurs villages,
verses.am: ዮቅድዓም፥ ዛኖዋሕ፥ ቃይን፥ ጊብዓ፥ ተምና፤ አሥር ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
verses.fr: Asdod, les villes de son ressort, et ses villages; Gaza, les villes de son ressort, et ses villages, jusqu''au torrent d''Egypte, et à la grande mer, qui sert de limite.
verses.am: ዮቅድዓም፥ ዛኖዋሕ፥ ቃይን፥ ጊብዓ፥ ተምና፤ አሥር ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.fr: Dans la montagne: Schamir, Jatthir, Soco,
verses.am: ቂርያትይዓሪም የምትባለው ቂርያትበኣል፥ ረባት፤ ሁለት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which is Debir,
verses.fr: Danna, Kirjath-Sanna, qui est Debir,
verses.am: ቂርያትይዓሪም የምትባለው ቂርያትበኣል፥ ረባት፤ ሁለት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
verses.fr: Anab, Eschthemo, Anim,
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ ቤትዓረባ፥ ሚዲን፥ ስካካ፥

verses.en: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
verses.fr: Gosen, Holon, et Guilo, onze villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ኒብሻን፥ የጨው ከተማ፥ ዓይንጋዲ፤ ስድስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
verses.fr: Arab, Duma, Eschean,
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም የተቀመጡትን ኢያቡሳውያንን ግን የይሁዳ ልጆች ሊያሳድዱአቸው አልተቻላቸውም፤ ኢያቡሳውያንም እስከ ዛሬ በይሁዳ ልጆች መካከል በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.en: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah,
verses.fr: Janum, Beth-Tappuach, Aphéka,
verses.am: ፤ አራብ፥ ዱማ፥ ኤሽዓን፥ ያኒም፥ ቤትታጱዋ፥

verses.en: And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
verses.fr: Humta, Kirjath-Arba, qui est Hébron, et Tsior; neuf villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ፤ አፌቃ፥ ሑምጣ፥ ኬብሮን የምትባል ቂርያትአርባቅ፥ ጺዖር፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
verses.fr: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juta,

verses.en: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
verses.fr: Jizreel, Jokdeam, Zanoach,
verses.am: ፤ ማዖን፥ ቀርሜሎስ፥ ዚፍ፥ ዩጣ፥ ኢይዝራኤል፥

verses.en: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
verses.fr: Kaïn, Guibea, et Thimna; dix villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ፤ ዮቅድዓም፥ ዛኖዋሕ፥ ቃይን፥ ጊብዓ፥ ተምና፤ አሥር ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
verses.fr: Halhul, Beth-Tsur, Guedor,

verses.en: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
verses.fr: Maarath, Beth-Anoth, et Elthekon; six villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ፤ ሐልሑል፥ ቤትጹር፥ ጌዶር፥ ማዕራት፥ ቤትዓኖት፥ ኤልትቆን፤ ስድስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
verses.fr: Kirjath-Baal, qui est Kirjath-Jearim, et Rabba; deux villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ፤ ቂርያትይዓሪም የምትባለው ቂርያትበኣል፥ ረባት፤ ሁለት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
verses.fr: Dans le désert: Beth-Araba, Middin, Secaca,
verses.am: ፤ በምድረ በዳ ቤትዓረባ፥ ሚዲን፥ ስካካ፥

verses.en: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.fr: Nibschan, Ir-Hammélach, et En-Guédi; six villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ፤ ኒብሻን፥ የጨው ከተማ፥ ዓይንጋዲ፤ ስድስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.fr: Les fils de Juda ne purent pas chasser les Jébusiens qui habitaient à Jérusalem, et les Jébusiens ont habité avec les fils de Juda à Jérusalem jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: ፤ በኢየሩሳሌም የተቀመጡትን ኢያቡሳውያንን ግን የይሁዳ ልጆች ሊያሳድዱአቸው አልተቻላቸውም፤ ኢያቡሳውያንም እስከ ዛሬ በይሁዳ ልጆች መካከል በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.en: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,
verses.fr: La part échue par le sort aux fils de Joseph s''étendait depuis le Jourdain près de Jéricho, vers les eaux de Jéricho, à l''orient. La limite suivait le désert qui s''élève de Jéricho à Béthel par la montagne.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ልጆች ዕጣ በኢያሪኮ አጠገብ በምሥራቁ በኩል ካለው ከዮርዳኖስ አንሥቶ በምድረ በዳውና በተራራማው በኩል ከኢያሪኮ ወደ ቤቴል ወጣ፤

verses.en: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
verses.fr: Elle continuait de Béthel à Luz, et passait vers la frontière des Arkiens par Atharoth.
verses.am: ከቤቴል ወደ ሎዛ ወጣ፥ በአርካውያንም ዳርቻ በኩል ወደ አጣሮት አለፈ፥

verses.en: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer; and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
verses.fr: Puis elle descendait à l''occident vers la frontière des Japhléthiens jusqu''à celle de Beth-Horon la basse et jusqu''à Guézer, pour aboutir à la mer.
verses.am: ወደ ምዕራብም እስከ የፍሌጣውያን ዳርቻ እስከ ታችኛው ቤትሖሮን ዳርቻ እስከ ጌዝር ድረስ ወረደ፥ መውጫውም በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.fr: C''est là que reçurent leur héritage les fils de Joseph, Manassé et Ephraïm.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ልጆች ምናሴና ኤፍሬም ርስታቸውን ወረሱ።

verses.en: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, unto Bethhoron the upper;
verses.fr: Voici les limites des fils d''Ephraïm, selon leurs familles. La limite de leur héritage était, à l''orient, Atharoth-Addar jusqu''à Beth-Horon la haute.
verses.am: የኤፍሬምም ልጆች ድንበር በየወገኖቻቸው እንደዚህ ነበረ፤ በምሥራቅ በኩል የርስታቸው ድንበር አጣሮትአዳር እስከ ላይኛው ቤትሖሮን ድረስ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
verses.fr: Elle continuait du côté de l''occident vers Micmethath au nord, tournait à l''orient vers Thaanath-Silo, et passait dans la direction de l''orient par Janoach.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ምዕራብ ወደ ሚክምታት በሰሜን በኩል ወጣ፤ ድንበሩም ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደ ተአናትሴሎ ዞረ፥ ወደ ኢያኖክ በምሥራቅ በኩል አለፈ፥

verses.en: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
verses.fr: De Janoach elle descendait à Atharoth et à Naaratha, touchait à Jéricho, et se prolongeait jusqu''au Jourdain.
verses.am: ከኢያኖክም ወደ አጣሮትና ወደ ነዓራት ወረደ፤ ወደ ኢያሪኮም ደረሰ፥ ወደ ዮርዳኖስም ወጣ።

verses.en: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
verses.fr: De Tappuach elle allait vers l''occident au torrent de Kana, pour aboutir à la mer. Tel fut l''héritage de la tribu des fils d''Ephraïm, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ከታጱዋ ወደ ምዕራብ እስከ ቃና ወንዝ ድረስ አለፈ፥ መውጫውም በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ። የኤፍሬም ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Ephraïm avaient aussi des villes séparées au milieu de l''héritage des fils de Manassé, toutes avec leurs villages.
verses.am: ይኸውም በምናሴ ልጆች ርስት መካከል ለኤፍሬም ልጆች ከተለዩ ከተሞች ጋር፥ ከተሞች ሁሉ ከመንደሮቻቸው ጋር፥ ነው።

verses.en: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
verses.fr: Ils ne chassèrent point les Cananéens qui habitaient à Guézer, et les Cananéens ont habité au milieu d''Ephraïm jusqu''à ce jour, mais ils furent assujettis à un tribut.
verses.am: በጌዝርም የተቀመጡትን ከነዓናውያንን አላሳደዱአቸውም፥ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ከነዓናውያን በኤፍሬም መካከል ተቀምጠዋል፤ የጕልበት ግብርም ያስገብሩአቸው ነበር። a

verses.en: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.fr: Une part échut aussi par le sort à la tribu de Manassé, car il était le premier-né de Joseph. Makir, premier-né de Manassé et père de Galaad, avait eu Galaad et Basan, parce qu''il était un homme de guerre.
verses.am: ለምናሴ ነገድ ዕጣ ይህ ነው፤ የዮሴፍ በኵር እርሱ ነውና። የምናሴም በኵር የገለዓድ አባት ማኪር ብርቱ ሰልፈኛ ስለ ነበረ ገለዓድንና ባሳንን ወረሰ።

verses.en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
verses.fr: On donna par le sort une part aux autres fils de Manassé, selon leurs familles, aux fils d''Abiézer, aux fils de Hélek, aux fils d''Asriel, aux fils de Sichem, aux fils de Hépher, aux fils de Schemida: ce sont là les enfants mâles de Manassé, fils de Joseph, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: ዕጣውም ለቀሩት ለምናሴ ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው፥ ለአቢዔዝር ልጆች፥ ለኬሌግ ልጆች፥ ለአሥሪኤል ልጆች፥ ለሴኬም ልጆች፥ ለኦፌር ልጆች፥ ለሸሚዳ ልጆች ሆነ፤ የዮሴፍ ልጅ የምናሴ ወንዶች ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.fr: Tselophchad, fils de Hépher, fils de Galaad, fils de Makir, fils de Manassé, n''eut point de fils, mais il eut des filles dont voici les noms: Machla, Noa, Hogla, Milca et Thirtsa.
verses.am: ለምናሴ ልጅ፥ ለማኪር ልጅ፥ ለገለዓድ ልጅ፥ ለኦፌር ልጅ፥ ለሰለጰዓድ ግን ሴቶች ልጆች እንጂ ወንዶች ልጆች አልነበሩትም የሴቶች ልጆቹም ስም ማህለህ፥ ኑዓ፥ ዔግላ፥ ሚልካ፥ ቲርጻ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
verses.fr: Elles se présentèrent devant le sacrificateur Eléazar, devant Josué, fils de Nun, et devant les princes, en disant: L''Eternel a commandé à Moïse de nous donner un héritage parmi nos frères. Et on leur donna, selon l''ordre de l''Eternel, un héritage parmi les frères de leur père.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አልዓዛርና ወደ ነዌ ልጅ ወደ ኢያሱ ወደ አለቆችም ቀርበው። እግዚአብሔር በወንድሞቻችን መካከል ርስት እንዲሰጠን ሙሴን አዘዘ አሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘ በአባታቸው ወንድሞች መካከል ርስት ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
verses.fr: Il échut dix portions à Manassé, outre le pays de Galaad et de Basan, qui est de l''autre côté du Jourdain.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ካለው ከገለዓድና ከባሳን አገር ሌላ ለምናሴ አሥር ዕጣ ሆነ፤

verses.en: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
verses.fr: Car les filles de Manassé eurent un héritage parmi ses fils, et le pays de Galaad fut pour les autres fils de Manassé.
verses.am: የምናሴ ሴቶች ልጆች በወንዶች ልጆች መካከል ርስት ተቀብለዋልና፤ የገለዓድም ምድር ለቀሩት ለምናሴ ልጆች ሆኖአልና።

verses.en: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
verses.fr: La limite de Manassé s''étendait d''Aser à Micmethath, qui est près de Sichem, et allait à Jamin vers les habitants d''En-Tappuach.
verses.am: የምናሴም ድንበር ከአሴር ጀምሮ በሴኬም ፊት ልፊት እስካለው እስከ ሚክምታት ድረስ ነበረ፤ ድንበሩም በቀኝ በኩል ወደ ዓይንታጱዋ ሰዎች አለፈ።

verses.en: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
verses.fr: Le pays de Tappuach était aux fils de Manassé, mais Tappuach sur la frontière de Manassé était aux fils d''Ephraïm.
verses.am: የታጱዋ ምድር ለምናሴ ነበረ፤ በምናሴ ዳርቻ ያለው ታጱዋ ግን ለኤፍሬም ልጆች ሆነ።

verses.en: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
verses.fr: La limite descendait au torrent de Kana, au midi du torrent. Ces villes étaient à Ephraïm, au milieu des villes de Manassé. La limite de Manassé au nord du torrent aboutissait à la mer.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ቃና ወንዝ ከወንዙ በደቡብ ወገን ወረደ፤ በምናሴም ከተሞች መካከል የነበሩት እነዚህ ከተሞች ለኤፍሬም ሆኑ፤ የምናሴም ድንበር በወንዙ በኩል በሰሜን ወገን ነበረ፥ መውጫውም በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
verses.fr: Le territoire du midi était à Ephraïm, celui du nord à Manassé, et la mer leur servait de limite; ils touchaient à Aser vers le nord, et à Issacar vers l''orient.
verses.am: በደቡብ በኩል ያለው ለኤፍሬም ነበረ፥ በሰሜንም በኩል ያለው ለምናሴ ነበረ፥ ድንበሩም ባሕሩ ነበረ፤ በሰሜን በኩል ወደ አሴር፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ወደ ይሳኮር ደረሰ።

verses.en: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
verses.fr: Manassé possédait dans Issacar et dans Aser: Beth-Schean et les villes de son ressort, Jibleam et les villes de son ressort, les habitants de Dor et les villes de son ressort, les habitants d''En-Dor et les villes de son ressort, les habitants de Thaanac et les villes de son ressort, et les habitants de Meguiddo et les villes de son ressort, trois contrées.
verses.am: በይሳኮርና በአሴር መካከል ቤትሳንና መንደሮችዋ፥ ይብልዓምና መንደሮችዋ፥ ዶርና የመንደሮችዋ ሰዎች፥ ዓይንዶርና የመንደሮችዋ ሰዎች፥ ታዕናክና የመንደሮችዋ ሰዎች፥ መጊዶና የመንደሮችዋ ሰዎች፥ ሦስቱ ኮረብቶች ለምናሴ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.fr: Les fils de Manassé ne purent pas prendre possession de ces villes, et les Cananéens voulurent rester dans ce pays.
verses.am: የምናሴ ልጆች ግን የእነዚህን ከተሞች ሰዎች ሊያሳድዱአቸው አልቻሉም፤ ነገር ግን ከነዓናውያን በዚያ አገር በመቀመጥ ጸኑ።

verses.en: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.fr: Lorsque les enfants d''Israël furent assez forts, ils assujettirent les Cananéens à un tribut, mais ils ne les chassèrent point.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በጸኑ ጊዜ ከነዓናውያንን የጕልበት ግብር አስገበሩአቸው፥ ፈጽመውም አላሳደዱአቸውም።

verses.en: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the Lord hath blessed me hitherto?
verses.fr: Les fils de Joseph parlèrent à Josué, et dirent: Pourquoi nous as-tu donné en héritage un seul lot, une seule part, tandis que nous formons un peuple nombreux et que l''Eternel nous a bénis jusqu''à présent?
verses.am: የዮሴፍ ልጆች ኢያሱን። እኔ ብዙ ሕዝብ ስለ ሆንሁ እስከ አሁንም እግዚአብሔር ስለ ባረከኝ ለምን አንድ ክፍል አንድም ዕጣ ብቻ ርስት አድርገህ ሰጠኸኝ? አሉት።

verses.en: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
verses.fr: Josué leur dit: Si vous êtes un peuple nombreux, montez à la forêt, et vous l''abattrez pour vous y faire de la place dans le pays des Phéréziens et des Rephaïm, puisque la montagne d''Ephraïm est trop étroite pour vous.
verses.am: ኢያሱም። ብዙ ሕዝብስ ከሆንህ ተራራማውም የኤፍሬም አገር ጠብቦህ እንደ ሆነ ወደ ዱር ወጥተህ በፌርዛውያንና በራፋይም ምድር ለአንተ ስፍራ መንጥር አላቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
verses.fr: Les fils de Joseph dirent: La montagne ne nous suffira pas, et il y a des chars de fer chez tous les Cananéens qui habitent la vallée, chez ceux qui sont à Beth-Schean et dans les villes de son ressort, et chez ceux qui sont dans la vallée de Jizreel.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ልጆች። ተራራማው አገር አይበቃንም፤ በሸለቆውም ውስጥ ለሚኖሩት፥ በቤትሳንና በመንደሮችዋ በኢይዝራኤልም ሸለቆ ለሚኖሩት ከነዓናውያን የብረት ሰረገሎች አላቸው አሉት።

verses.en: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
verses.fr: Josué dit à la maison de Joseph, à Ephraïm et à Manassé: Vous êtes un peuple nombreux, et votre force est grande, vous n''aurez pas un simple lot.
verses.am: ኢያሱም የዮሴፍ ወገን ለሚሆኑ ለኤፍሬምና ለምናሴ። አንተ ብዙ ሕዝብ ነህ፥ ጽኑም ኃይል አለህ አንድ ዕጣ ብቻ አይሆንልህም፤

verses.en: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
verses.fr: Mais vous aurez la montagne, car c''est une forêt que vous abattrez et dont les issues seront à vous, et vous chasserez les Cananéens, malgré leurs chars de fer et malgré leur force.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ተራራማው አገር ለአንተ ይሆናል፥ ዱር እንኳን ቢሆንም ትመነጥረዋለህ፥ ለአንተም ይሆናል፤ ለከነዓናውያንም የብረት ሰረገሎች ቢሆኑላቸው የበረቱም ቢሆኑ ታሳድዳቸዋለህ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël se réunit à Silo, et ils y placèrent la tente d''assignation. Le pays était soumis devant eux.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በሴሎ ተሰበሰቡ፥ በዚያም የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ተከሉ፤ ምድሩም ጸጥ ብሎ ተገዛላቸው።

verses.en: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.fr: Il restait sept tribus des enfants d''Israël qui n''avaient pas encore reçu leur héritage.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ርስት ያልተካፈሉ ሰባት ነገድ ቀርተው ነበር።

verses.en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the Lord God of your fathers hath given you?
verses.fr: Josué dit aux enfants d''Israël: Jusques à quand négligerez-vous de prendre possession du pays que l''Eternel, le Dieu de vos pères, vous a donné?
verses.am: ኢያሱም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አላቸው። የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር የሰጣችሁን ምድር ትወርሱ ዘንድ እስከ መቼ ለመግባት ቸል ትላላችሁ?

verses.en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
verses.fr: Choisissez trois hommes par tribu, et je les ferai partir. Ils se lèveront, parcourront le pays, traceront un plan en vue du partage, et reviendront auprès de moi.
verses.am: ከየነገዱ ሁሉ ሦስት ሦስት ሰዎች ምረጡ፥ እኔም እልካቸዋለሁ፤ ተነሥተውም አገሩን ይዞራሉ፥ እንደ ርስታቸውም መጠን ይጽፉታል፤ ወደ እኔም ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
verses.fr: Ils le diviseront en sept parts; Juda restera dans ses limites au midi, et la maison de Joseph restera dans ses limites au nord.
verses.am: በሰባትም ክፍል ይከፍሉታል፤ ይሁዳ በደቡብ በኩል በዳርቻው ውስጥ ይቀመጣል፤ የዮሴፍ ወገኖች በሰሜን በኩል በዳርቻው ውስጥ ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.
verses.fr: Vous donc, vous tracerez un plan du pays en sept parts, et vous me l''apporterez ici. Je jetterai pour vous le sort devant l''Eternel, notre Dieu.
verses.am: እናንተም ምድሩን በሰባት ክፍል ጻፉት፥ የጻፋችሁትንም ወዲህ አምጡልኝ፤ በአምላካችንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በዚህ ዕጣ አጣጥላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.
verses.fr: Mais il n''y aura point de part pour les Lévites au milieu de vous, car le sacerdoce de l''Eternel est leur héritage; et Gad, Ruben et la demi-tribu de Manassé ont reçu leur héritage, que Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, leur a donné de l''autre côté du Jourdain, à l''orient.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ክህነት ርስታቸው ነውና ለሌዋውያን በመካከላችሁ እድል ፈንታ የላቸውም፤ ጋድም ሮቤልም የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምሥራቅ በኩል የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ የሰጣቸውን ርስታቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.en: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the Lord in Shiloh.
verses.fr: Lorsque ces hommes se levèrent et partirent pour tracer un plan du pays, Josué leur donna cet ordre: Allez, parcourez le pays, tracez-en un plan, et revenez auprès de moi; puis je jetterai pour vous le sort devant l''Eternel, à Silo.
verses.am: ሰዎችም ተነሥተው ሄዱ፤ ኢያሱም ምድሩን ሊጽፉ የሄዱትን። ሂዱ፥ ምድሩንም ዞራችሁ ጻፉት፥ ወደ እኔም ተመለሱ፤ በዚህም በሴሎ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዕጣ አጣጥላችኋለሁ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
verses.fr: Ces hommes partirent, parcoururent le pays, et en tracèrent d''après les villes un plan en sept parts, dans un livre; et ils revinrent auprès de Josué dans le camp à Silo.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ሄደው ምድሩን ዞሩ፥ እንደ ከተሞችም በሰባት ክፍል ከፈሉት፥ በመጽሐፍም ጻፉት፤ ኢያሱም ወደ ሰፈረበት ወደ ሴሎ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.fr: Josué jeta pour eux le sort à Silo devant l''Eternel, et il fit le partage du pays entre les enfants d''Israël, en donnant à chacun sa portion.
verses.am: ኢያሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሴሎ ዕጣ አጣጣላቸው፤ በዚያም ኢያሱ ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንደ ክፍሎቻቸው ምድሩን ከፈለ።

verses.en: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.fr: Le sort tomba sur la tribu des fils de Benjamin, selon leurs familles, et la part qui leur échut par le sort avait ses limites entre les fils de Juda et les fils de Joseph.
verses.am: የብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ ዕጣ በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ፤ የዕጣቸውም ዳርቻ በይሁዳ ልጆችና በዮሴፍ ልጆች መካከል ወጣ።

verses.en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
verses.fr: Du côté septentrional, leur limite partait du Jourdain. Elle montait au nord de Jéricho, s''élevait dans la montagne vers l''occident, et aboutissait au désert de Beth-Aven.
verses.am: በሰሜን በኩል ድንበራቸው ከዮርዳኖስ ጀመረ፤ ድንበሩም ወደ ኢያሪኮ ወደ ሰሜን ወገን ወጣ፥ ከዚያም በተራራማው አገር ወደ ምዕራብ ወጣ፥ መውጫውም በቤትአዌን ምድረ በዳ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
verses.fr: Elle passait de là par Luz, au midi de Luz, qui est Béthel, et elle descendait à Atharoth-Addar par-dessus la montagne qui est au midi de Beth-Horon la basse.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ከዚያ በደቡብ በኩል ቤቴል ወደምትባል ወደ ሎዛ አለፈ፤ ድንበሩም በታችኛው ቤትሖሮን በደቡብ በኩል ባለው ተራራ ወደ አጣሮትአዳር ወረደ።

verses.en: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Bethhoron southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
verses.fr: Du côté occidental, la limite se prolongeait et tournait au midi depuis la montagne qui est vis-à-vis de Beth-Horon; elle continuait vers le midi, et aboutissait à Kirjath-Baal, qui est Kirjath-Jearim, ville des fils de Juda. C''était le côté occidental.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ምዕራብ ሄደ፥ በቤትሖሮንም ፊት ለፊት ካለው ተራራ ወደ ደቡብ ዞረ፤ መውጫውም ቂርያትይዓሪም በምትባል በይሁዳ ልጆች ከተማ በቂርያትበኣል ነበረ፤ ይህ የምዕራቡ ዳርቻ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
verses.fr: Le côté méridional commençait à l''extrémité de Kirjath-Jearim. La limite se prolongeait vers l''occident jusqu''à la source des eaux de Nephthoach.
verses.am: የደቡብም ዳርቻ ከቂርያትይዓሪም መጨረሻ ነበረ፤ ድንበሩም በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ነፍቶ ውኃ ምንጭ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,
verses.fr: Elle descendait à l''extrémité de la montagne qui est vis-à-vis de la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, dans la vallée des Rephaïm au nord. Elle descendait par la vallée de Hinnom, sur le côté méridional des Jébusiens, jusqu''à En-Roguel.
verses.am: ድንበሩም በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ተራራ መጨረሻ ወረደ፥ እርሱም በራፋይም ሸሰቆ በሰሜን በኩል ነው፤ ወደ ሄኖም ሸለቆ ወደ ኢያቡስ ዳር በደቡብ በኩል ወረደ፥ ወደ ዓይንሮጌልም ወረደ።

verses.en: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
verses.fr: Elle se dirigeait vers le nord à En-Schémesch, puis à Gueliloth, qui est vis-à-vis de la montée d''Adummim, et elle descendait à la pierre de Bohan, fils de Ruben.
verses.am: ወደ ሰሜንም አለፈ በቤትሳሚስ ምንጭ ላይ ወጣ፥ በአዱሚም ዐቀበት ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ወደ ጌሊሎት ደረሰ፤ ወደ ሮቤልም ልጅ ወደ ቦሀን ድንጋይ ወረደ፤

verses.en: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:
verses.fr: Elle passait sur le côté septentrional en face d''Araba, descendait à Araba,
verses.am: በሰሜንም ወገን ወደ ዓረባ አጠገብ አለፈ፥ ወደ ዓረባም ወረደ፤

verses.en: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
verses.fr: et continuait sur le côté septentrional de Beth-Hogla, pour aboutir à la langue septentrionale de la mer Salée, vers l''embouchure du Jourdain au midi. C''était la limite méridionale.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ቤትሖግላ ወደ ሰሜን ወገን አለፈ፤ መውጫውም በዮርዳኖስ መጨረሻ በደቡብ በኩል ባለው በጨው ባሕር ልሳን አጠገብ ነበረ፤ ይህ የደቡቡ ዳርቻ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
verses.fr: Du côté oriental, le Jourdain formait la limite. Tel fut l''héritage des fils de Benjamin, selon leurs familles, avec ses limites de tous les côtés.
verses.am: በምሥራቅም በኩል ድንበሩ ዮርዳኖስ ነበረ። ይህ በዙርያቸው ዳርቻ በየወገኖቻቸው የብንያም ልጆች ርስት ነበረ።

verses.en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
verses.fr: Les villes de la tribu des fils de Benjamin, selon leurs familles, étaient: Jéricho, Beth-Hogla, Emek-Ketsits,
verses.am: የብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ ከተሞች በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ኢያሪኮ፥ ቤትሖግላ፥ ዓመቀጺጽ፥

verses.en: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
verses.fr: Beth-Araba, Tsemaraïm, Béthel,
verses.am: ቤትዓረባ፥ ዘማራይም፥ ቤቴል፥

verses.en: And Avim, and Pharah, and Ophrah,
verses.fr: Avvim, Para, Ophra,
verses.am: ገባዖን፥ ራማ፥ ብኤሮት፥

verses.en: And Chepharhaammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.fr: Kephar-Ammonaï, Ophni et Guéba; douze villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ገባዖን፥ ራማ፥ ብኤሮት፥

verses.en: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
verses.fr: Gabaon, Rama, Beéroth,
verses.am: ምጽጳ፥ ከፊራ፥ አሞቂ፥

verses.en: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
verses.fr: Mitspé, Kephira, Motsa,
verses.am: ፤ ምጽጳ፥ ከፊራ፥ አሞቂ፥

verses.en: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
verses.fr: Rékem, Jirpeel, Thareala,

verses.en: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.fr: Tséla, Eleph, Jebus, qui est Jérusalem, Guibeath, et Kirjath; quatorze villes, et leurs villages. Tel fut l''héritage des fils de Benjamin, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: ፤ ሬቄም፥ ይርጵኤል፥ ተርአላ፥ ጼላ፥ ኤሌፍ፥ ኢየሩሳሌም የምትባል የኢያቡስ ከተማ፥ ቂርያትጊብዓት፤ አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው። የብንያም ልጆች ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.fr: La seconde part échut par le sort à Siméon, à la tribu des fils de Siméon, selon leurs familles. Leur héritage était au milieu de l''héritage des fils de Juda.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውም ዕጣ ለስምዖን ልጆች ነገድ በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ፤ ርስታቸውም በይሁዳ ልጆች ርስት መከከል ነበረ።

verses.en: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,
verses.fr: Ils eurent dans leur héritage: Beer-Schéba, Schéba, Molada,
verses.am: እነዚህም ርስታቸው ሆኑላቸው፤ ቤርሳቤህ፥ ሤባ፥ ሞላዳ፥

verses.en: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,
verses.fr: Hatsar-Schual, Bala, Atsem,
verses.am: ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ባላ፥ ዔጼም፥ ኤልቶላድ፥

verses.en: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
verses.fr: Eltholad, Bethul, Horma,
verses.am: ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ባላ፥ ዔጼም፥ ኤልቶላድ፥

verses.en: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,
verses.fr: Tsiklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hatsar-Susa,
verses.am: በቱል፥ ሔርማ፥ ጺቅላግ፥ ቤትማርካቦት፥

verses.en: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
verses.fr: Beth-Lebaoth et Scharuchen, treize villes, et leurs villages;
verses.am: ሐጸርሱሳ፥ ቤተ ለባኦት፥ ሻሩሔን፤ አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው፤

verses.en: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
verses.fr: Aïn, Rimmon, Ether, et Aschan, quatre villes, et leurs villages;
verses.am: ዓይን፥ ሪሞን፥ ዔቴር፥ አሻን፤ አራት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው፤

verses.en: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.fr: et tous les villages aux environs de ces villes, jusqu''à Baalath-Beer, qui est Ramath du midi. Tel fut l''héritage de la tribu des fils de Siméon, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: እስከ ባዕላትብኤርና እስከ ደቡቡ ራማት ድረስ በእነዚህ ከተሞች ዙሪያ ያሉ መንደሮች ሁሉ። የስምዖን ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
verses.fr: L''héritage des fils de Siméon fut pris sur la portion des fils de Juda; car la portion des fils de Juda était trop grande pour eux, et c''est au milieu de leur héritage que les fils de Siméon reçurent le leur.
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ልጆች ክፍል የስምዖን ልጆች ርስት ሆነ፤ የይሁዳም ልጆች እድል ፈንታ ስለ በዛባቸው የስምዖን ልጆች በርስታቸው መካከል ወረሱ።

verses.en: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
verses.fr: La troisième part échut par le sort aux fils de Zabulon, selon leurs familles. La limite de leur héritage s''étendait jusqu''à Sarid.
verses.am: ሦስተኛውም ዕጣ ለዛብሎን ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ፤ የርስታቸውም ድንበር ወደ ሣሪድ ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
verses.fr: Elle montait à l''occident vers Mareala, et touchait à Dabbéscheth, puis au torrent qui coule devant Jokneam.
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ መርዓላ ወጣ፥ እስከ ደባሼትም ደረሰ፤ በዮቅንዓም ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ወንዝ ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
verses.fr: De Sarid elle tournait à l''orient, vers le soleil levant, jusqu''à la frontière de Kisloth-Thabor, continuait à Dabrath, et montait à Japhia.
verses.am: ከሣሪድም ወደ ፀሐይ መውጫ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደ ኪስሎትታቦር ዳርቻ ዞረ፤

verses.en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;
verses.fr: De là elle passait à l''orient par Guittha-Hépher, par Ittha-Katsin, continuait à Rimmon, et se prolongeait jusqu''à Néa.
verses.am: ወደ ዳብራትም ወጣ፥ ወደ ያፊዓም ደረሰ፤ ከዚያም በምሥራቅ በኩል ወደ ጋትሔፍርና ወደ ዒታቃጺን አለፈ፤ ወደ ሪምንና ወደ ኒዓ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
verses.fr: Elle tournait ensuite du côté du nord vers Hannathon, et aboutissait à la vallée de Jiphthach-El.
verses.am: ድንበሩም በሰሜን በኩል ወደ ሐናቶን ዞረ፥ መውጫውም በይፍታሕኤል ሸለቆ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
verses.fr: De plus, Katthath, Nahalal, Schimron, Jideala, Bethléhem. Douze villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ቀጣት፥ ነህላል፥ ሺምሮን፥ ይዳላ፥ ቤተ ልሔም፤ አሥራ ሁለት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.fr: Tel fut l''héritage des fils de Zabulon, selon leurs familles, ces villes-là et leurs villages.
verses.am: የዛብሎን ልጆች ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.fr: La quatrième part échut par le sort à Issacar, aux fils d''Issacar, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: አራተኛውም ዕጣ ለይሳኮር ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
verses.fr: Leur limite passait par Jizreel, Kesulloth, Sunem,
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ወደ ኢይዝራኤል፥

verses.en: And Haphraim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,
verses.fr: Hapharaïm, Schion, Anacharath,
verses.am: ወደ ከስሎት፥ ወደ ሱነም፥ ወደ ሐፍራይም፥ ወደ ሺኦን፥ ወደ አናሐራት፥

verses.en: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
verses.fr: Rabbith, Kischjon, Abets,
verses.am: ወደ ረቢት፥ ወደ ቂሶን፥ ወደ አቤጽ፥

verses.en: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;
verses.fr: Rémeth, En-Gannim, En-Hadda, et Beth-Patsets;
verses.am: ወደ ሬሜት፥ ወደ ዓይንጋኒም፥ ወደ ዓይንሐዳ፥ ወደ ቤትጳጼጽ ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.fr: elle touchait à Thabor, à Schachatsima, à Beth-Schémesch, et aboutissait au Jourdain. Seize villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ታቦርና ወደ ሻሕጹማ፥ ወደ ቤትሳሚስ ደረሰ፥ የድንበራቸውም መውጫ ዮርዳኖስ ነበረ፤ አሥራ ስድስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.fr: Tel fut l''héritage de la tribu des fils d''Issacar, selon leurs familles, ces villes-là et leurs villages.
verses.am: የይሳኮር ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.fr: La cinquième part échut par le sort à la tribu des fils d''Aser, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: አምስተኛውም ዕጣ ለአሴር ልጆች ነገድ በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
verses.fr: Leur limite passait par Helkath, Hali, Béthen, Acschaph,
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ሔልቃት፥ ሐሊ፥ ቤጤን፥ አዚፍ፥

verses.en: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;
verses.fr: Allammélec, Amead et Mischeal; elle touchait, vers l''occident, au Carmel et au Schichor-Libnath;
verses.am: አላሜሌክ፥ ዓምዓድ፥ ሚሽአል ነበረ፤ በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ቀርሜሎስና ወደ ሺሖርሊብናት ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Bethdagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthahel toward the north side of Bethemek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
verses.fr: puis elle tournait du côté de l''orient à Beth-Dagon, atteignait Zabulon et la vallée de Jiphthach-El au nord de Beth-Emek et de Neïel, et se prolongeait vers Cabul, à gauche,
verses.am: ወደ ፀሐይም መውጫ ወደ ቤትዳጎን ዞረ፥ ወደ ዛብሎንም ወደ ይፍታሕኤል ሸለቆ፥ በሰሜን በኩል ወደ ቤትዔሜቅና ወደ ንዒኤልም ደረሰ፤ በስተ ግራ በኩልም ወደ ካቡል ወጣ፤

verses.en: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
verses.fr: et vers Ebron, Rehob, Hammon et Kana, jusqu''à Sidon la grande.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወደ ዔብሮን፥ ወደ ረአብ፥ ወደ ሐሞን፥ ወደ ቃና እስከ ታላቁ ሲዶናም ደረሰ።

verses.en: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
verses.fr: Elle tournait ensuite vers Rama jusqu''à la ville forte de Tyr, et vers Hosa, pour aboutir à la mer, par la contrée d''Aczib.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ራማ፥ ወደ ተመሸገውም ከተማ ወደ ጢሮስ ዞረ፤ ድንበሩም ወደ ሖሳ ዞረ፤ መውጫውም በአክዚብ በኩል ወደ ባሕሩ ነበረ፤

verses.en: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
verses.fr: De plus, Umma, Aphek et Rehob. Vingt-deux villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: ዑማ፥ አፌቅ፥ ረአብ ደግሞ ነበሩ፤ ሀያ ሁለት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.fr: Tel fut l''héritage de la tribu des fils d''Aser, selon leurs familles, ces villes-là et leurs villages.
verses.am: የአሴር ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.fr: La sixième part échut par le sort aux fils de Nephthali, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: ስድስተኛውም ዕጣ ለንፍታሌም ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
verses.fr: Leur limite s''étendait depuis Héleph, depuis Allon, par Tsaanannim, Adami-Nékeb et Jabneel, jusqu''à Lakkum, et elle aboutissait au Jourdain.
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ከሔሌፍ፥ ከጸዕነኒም ዛፍ፥ ከአዳሚኔቄብ፥ ከየብኒኤል እስከ ለቁም ድረስ ነበረ፤ መውጫውም በዮርዳኖስ ነበረ።

verses.en: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.fr: Elle tournait vers l''occident à Aznoth-Thabor, et de là continuait à Hukkok; elle touchait à Zabulon du côté du midi, à Aser du côté de l''occident, et à Juda; le Jourdain était du côté de l''orient.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ምዕራብ ወደ አዝኖትታቦር ዞረ፥ ከዚያም ወደ ሑቆቅ ወጣ፤ ከዚያም በደቡብ በኩል ወደ ዛብሎን፥ በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ አሴር፥ በዮርዳኖስም በፀሐይ መውጫ ወደ ይሁዳ ደረሰ።

verses.en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
verses.fr: Les villes fortes étaient: Tsiddim, Tser, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnéreth,
verses.am: የተመሸጉትም ከተሞች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ጺዲም፥ ጼር፥ ሐማት፥

verses.en: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
verses.fr: Adama, Rama, Hatsor,
verses.am: ረቃት፥ ኬኔሬት፥ አዳማ፥ ራማ፥ አሶር፥

verses.en: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,
verses.fr: Kédesch, Edréï, En-Hatsor,
verses.am: የንፍታሌም ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Bethanath, and Bethshemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
verses.fr: Jireon, Migdal-El, Horem, Beth-Anath et Beth-Schémesch. Dix-neuf villes, et leurs villages.
verses.am: የንፍታሌም ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.fr: Tel fut l''héritage de la tribu des fils de Nephthali, selon leurs familles, ces villes-là et leurs villages.
verses.am: ሰባተኛውም ዕጣ ለዳን ልጆች ነገድ በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
verses.fr: La septième part échut par le sort à la tribu des fils de Dan, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: የርስታቸውም ዳርቻ ይህ ነበረ፤ ጾርዓ፥ ኤሽታኦል፥ ዒርሼሜሽ፥

verses.en: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Irshemesh,
verses.fr: La limite de leur héritage comprenait Tsorea, Eschthaol, Ir-Schémesch,
verses.am: አቃሮን፥ ኢልተቄ፥ ገባቶን፥ ባዕላት፥

verses.en: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
verses.fr: Schaalabbin, Ajalon, Jithla,
verses.am: አቃሮን፥ ኢልተቄ፥ ገባቶን፥ ባዕላት፥

verses.en: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
verses.fr: Elon, Thimnatha, Ekron,
verses.am: የዳንም ልጆች ዳርቻ አልበቃቸውም፤ የዳንም ልጆች ከሌሼም ጋር ሊዋጉ ወጡ፥ ያዙአትም፥ በሰይፍም ስለት መቱአት፥ ወረሱአትም፥ ተቀመጡባትም፤ ስምዋንም በአባታቸው በዳን ስም ዳን ብለው ጠሩአት።

verses.en: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
verses.fr: Eltheké, Guibbethon, Baalath,
verses.am: የዳንም ልጆች ዳርቻ አልበቃቸውም፤ የዳንም ልጆች ከሌሼም ጋር ሊዋጉ ወጡ፥ ያዙአትም፥ በሰይፍም ስለት መቱአት፥ ወረሱአትም፥ ተቀመጡባትም፤ ስምዋንም በአባታቸው በዳን ስም ዳን ብለው ጠሩአት።

verses.en: And Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gathrimmon,
verses.fr: Jehud, Bené-Berak, Gath-Rimmon,
verses.am: የዳን ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
verses.fr: Mé-Jarkon et Rakkon, avec le territoire vis-à-vis de Japho.
verses.am: ምድሩንም ሁሉ በየድንበሩ ርስት እንዲሆን ከፍለው ከጨረሱ በኋላ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለነዌ ልጅ ለኢያሱ በመካከላቸው ርስት ሰጡት።

verses.en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
verses.fr: Le territoire des fils de Dan s''étendait hors de chez eux. Les fils de Dan montèrent et combattirent contre Léschem; ils s''en emparèrent et la frappèrent du tranchant de l''épée; ils en prirent possession, s''y établirent, et l''appelèrent Dan, du nom de Dan, leur père.
verses.am: በኤፍሬም ተራራማ አገር ያለችውን ተምናሴራ የምትባለውን የፈለጋትን ከተማ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ሰጡት፤ ከተማም ሠርቶ ተቀመጠባት።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.fr: Tel fut l''héritage de la tribu des fils de Dan, selon leurs familles, ces villes-là et leurs villages.
verses.am: ካህኑ አልዓዛር፥ የነዌም ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ነገዶች የአባቶች አለቆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሴሎ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ በዕጣ የተካፈሉት ርስት ይህ ነው። ምድሪቱንም መካፈል ጨረሱ።

verses.en: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils eurent achevé de faire le partage du pays, d''après ses limites, les enfants d''Israël donnèrent à Josué, fils de Nun, une possession au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: ፤ ምድሩንም ሁሉ በየድንበሩ ርስት እንዲሆን ከፍለው ከጨረሱ በኋላ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለነዌ ልጅ ለኢያሱ በመካከላቸው ርስት ሰጡት።

verses.en: According to the word of the Lord they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
verses.fr: Selon l''ordre de l''Eternel, ils lui donnèrent la ville qu''il demanda, Thimnath-Sérach, dans la montagne d''Ephraïm. Il rebâtit la ville, et y fit sa demeure.
verses.am: ፤ በኤፍሬም ተራራማ አገር ያለችውን ተምናሴራ የምትባለውን የፈለጋትን ከተማ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ሰጡት፤ ከተማም ሠርቶ ተቀመጠባት።

verses.en: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
verses.fr: Tels sont les héritages que le sacrificateur Eléazar, Josué, fils de Nun, et les chefs de famille des tribus des enfants d''Israël, distribuèrent par le sort devant l''Eternel à Silo, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation. Ils achevèrent ainsi le partage du pays.
verses.am: ፤ ካህኑ አልዓዛር፥ የነዌም ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ነገዶች የአባቶች አለቆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሴሎ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ በዕጣ የተካፈሉት ርስት ይህ ነው። ምድሪቱንም መካፈል ጨረሱ።

verses.en: The Lord also spake unto Joshua, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Josué, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis: Etablissez-vous, comme je vous l''ai ordonné par Moïse, des villes de refuge,
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። ሳይወድድ ሳያውቅም ሰውን የገደለ ገዳይ እንዲሸሽባቸው በሙሴ እጅ የነገርኋችሁን መማፀኛ ከተሞችን ለዩ፤ ከደም ተበቃዩ መማፀኛ ይሆኑላችኋል።

verses.en: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
verses.fr: où pourra s''enfuir le meurtrier qui aura tué quelqu''un involontairement, sans intention; elles vous serviront de refuge contre le vengeur du sang.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። ሳይወድድ ሳያውቅም ሰውን የገደለ ገዳይ እንዲሸሽባቸው በሙሴ እጅ የነገርኋችሁን መማፀኛ ከተሞችን ለዩ፤ ከደም ተበቃዩ መማፀኛ ይሆኑላችኋል።

verses.en: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
verses.fr: Le meurtrier s''enfuira vers l''une de ces villes, s''arrêtera à l''entrée de la porte de la ville, et exposera son cas aux anciens de cette ville; ils le recueilleront auprès d''eux dans la ville, et lui donneront une demeure, afin qu''il habite avec eux.
verses.am: ከእነዚህም ከተሞች ወደ አንዲቱ ይሸሻል፥ በከተማይቱም በር አደባባይ ቆሞ በከተማይቱ ሽማግሌዎች ጆሮ ነገሩን ይናገራል፤ እነርሱም ወደ ከተማይቱ ይቀበሉታል፥ የሚቀመጥበትም ስፍራ ይሰጡታል።

verses.en: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.
verses.fr: Si le vengeur du sang le poursuit, ils ne livreront point le meurtrier entre ses mains; car c''est sans le vouloir qu''il a tué son prochain, et sans avoir été auparavant son ennemi.
verses.am: ደም ተበቃዩ ቢያሳድደው፥ አስቀድሞ ሳይጠላው ባልንጀራውን በስሕተት ስለ ገደለው ነፍሰ ገዳዩን በእጁ አሳልፈው አይስጡት።

verses.en: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.
verses.fr: Il restera dans cette ville jusqu''à ce qu''il ait comparu devant l''assemblée pour être jugé, jusqu''à la mort du souverain sacrificateur alors en fonctions. A cette époque, le meurtrier s''en retournera et rentrera dans sa ville et dans sa maison, dans la ville d''où il s''était enfui.
verses.am: በማኅበሩ ፊት ለፍርድ እስኪቆም ድረስ፥ በዚያም ወራት ያለው ታላቁ ካህን እስኪሞት ድረስ በዚያች ከተማ ይቀመጥ፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ ነፍሰ ገዳዩ ይመለሳል፥ ወደ ከተማውም ወደ ቤቱም ሸሽቶ ወደ ወጣባትም ከተማ ይገባል።

verses.en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.
verses.fr: Ils consacrèrent Kédesch, en Galilée, dans la montagne de Nephthali; Sichem, dans la montagne d''Ephraïm; et Kirjath-Arba, qui est Hébron, dans la montagne de Juda.
verses.am: በንፍታሌም ባለው በተራራማው አገር በገሊላ ቃዴስን፥ በኤፍሬምም ባለው በተራራማው አገር ሴኬምን፥ በይሁዳም ባለው በተራራማው አገር ኬብሮን የምትባለውን ቂርያትአርባቅን ለዩ።

verses.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.fr: Et de l''autre côté du Jourdain, à l''orient de Jéricho, ils choisirent Betser, dans le désert, dans la plaine, dans la tribu de Ruben; Ramoth, en Galaad, dans la tribu de Gad; et Golan, en Basan, dans la tribu de Manassé.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ከኢያሪኮ ወደ ምሥራቅ ከሮቤል ነገድ በምድረ በዳው በደልዳላው ስፍራ ቦሶርን፥ ከጋድም ነገድ በገለዓድ ራሞትን፥ ከምናሴም ነገድ በባሳን ጎላንን ለዩ።

verses.en: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.
verses.fr: Telles furent les villes désignées pour tous les enfants d''Israël et pour l''étranger en séjour au milieu d''eux, afin que celui qui aurait tué quelqu''un involontairement pût s''y réfugier, et qu''il ne mourût pas de la main du vengeur du sang avant d''avoir comparu devant l''assemblée.
verses.am: በማኅበሩ ፊት እስኪቆም ድረስ በደም ተበቃዩ እጅ እንዳይሞት ሳያውቅ ሰውን የገደለ ወደዚያ እንዲሸሽ፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ በመካከላቸውም ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ የተለዩ ከተሞች እነዚህ ናቸው። a

verses.en: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
verses.fr: Les chefs de famille des Lévites s''approchèrent du sacrificateur Eléazar, de Josué, fils de Nun, et des chefs de famille des tribus des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: የሌዋውያን አባቶች አለቆች ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አልዓዛር፥ ወደ ነዌም ልጅ ወደ ኢያሱ፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ልጆች ነገዶች አለቆች ቀረቡ፤

verses.en: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
verses.fr: Ils leur parlèrent à Silo, dans le pays de Canaan, et dirent: L''Eternel a ordonné par Moïse qu''on nous donnât des villes pour habitation, et leurs banlieues pour notre bétail.
verses.am: በከነዓን ምድር ባለችው በሴሎ። እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ የምንቀመጥባቸውን ከተሞች፥ ለከብቶቻችንም መሰምርያዎች ትሰጡን ዘንድ አዝዞአል ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their suburbs.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël donnèrent alors aux Lévites, sur leur héritage, les villes suivantes et leurs banlieues, d''après l''ordre de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ከርስታቸው እነዚህን ከተሞችና መሰምርያቸውን ለሌዋውያን ሰጡ።

verses.en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.fr: On tira le sort pour les familles des Kehathites; et les Lévites, fils du sacrificateur Aaron, eurent par le sort treize villes de la tribu de Juda, de la tribu de Siméon et de la tribu de Benjamin;
verses.am: ለቀዓትም ወገኖች ዕጣ ወጣ፤ ሌዋውያንም ለነበሩ ለካህኑ ለአሮን ልጆች ከይሁዳ ነገድ፥ ከስምዖንም ነገድ፥ ከብንያምም ነገድ አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች በዕጣ ሆኑላቸው።

verses.en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.fr: les autres fils de Kehath eurent par le sort dix villes des familles de la tribu d''Ephraïm, de la tribu de Dan et de la demi-tribu de Manassé.
verses.am: ለቀሩትም ለቀዓት ልጆች ከኤፍሬም ነገድ፥ ከዳንም ነገድ፥ ከምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ አሥር ከተሞች በዕጣ ሆኑላቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.fr: Les fils de Guerschon eurent par le sort treize villes des familles de la tribu d''Issacar, de la tribu d''Aser, de la tribu de Nephthali et de la demi-tribu de Manassé en Basan.
verses.am: ለጌድሶንም ልጆች ከይሳኮር ነገድ፥ ከአሴርም ነገድ፥ ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ፥ በባሳንም ካለው ከምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች በዕጣ ሆኑላቸው።

verses.en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.fr: Les fils de Merari, selon leurs familles, eurent douze villes de la tribu de Ruben, de la tribu de Gad et de la tribu de Zabulon.
verses.am: ለሜራሪም ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ከሮቤል ነገድ፥ ከጋድም ነገድ፥ ከዛብሎንም ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ከተሞች ሆኑላቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël donnèrent aux Lévites, par le sort, ces villes et leurs banlieues, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné par Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ የእስራኤል ልጆች እነዚህን ከተሞችና መሰምርያቸውን ለሌዋውያን በዕጣ ሰጡ።

verses.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name.
verses.fr: Ils donnèrent de la tribu des fils de Juda et de la tribu des fils de Siméon les villes qui vont être nominativement désignées,
verses.am: ከይሁዳም ልጆች ነገድ ከስምዖንም ልጆች ነገድ በስማቸው የተጠሩትን እነዚህን ከተሞች ሰጡ።

verses.en: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
verses.fr: et qui furent pour les fils d''Aaron d''entre les familles des Kehathites et des fils de Lévi, car le sort les avait indiqués les premiers.
verses.am: የፊተኛው ዕጣ ለእነርሱ ስለ ወጣ የሌዊ ልጆች የቀዓት ወገን ለሆኑ ለአሮን ልጆች ሆኑ።

verses.en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.fr: Ils leur donnèrent Kirjath-Arba, qui est Hébron, dans la montagne de Juda, et la banlieue qui l''entoure: Arba était le père d''Anak.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ተራራማ አገር ያለችውን ቂርያትአርባቅ የምትባለውን ከተማ በዙሪያዋም ያለውን መሰምርያ ሰጡአቸው፤ እርስዋም ኬብሮን ናት፥ ይህም አርባቅ የዔናቅ አባት ነበረ።

verses.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
verses.fr: Le territoire de la ville et ses villages furent accordés à Caleb, fils de Jephunné, pour sa possession.
verses.am: የከተማይቱን እርሻ ግን መንደሮችዋንም ለዮፎኔ ልጅ ለካሌብ ርስት አድርገው ሰጡት።

verses.en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
verses.fr: Ils donnèrent donc aux fils du sacrificateur Aaron la ville de refuge pour les meurtriers, Hébron et sa banlieue, Libna et sa banlieue,
verses.am: ለካህኑም ለአሮን ልጆች እነዚህን ሰጡ፤ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን ኬብሮንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ልብናንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
verses.fr: Jatthir et sa banlieue, Eschthemoa et sa banlieue,
verses.am: የቲርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ኤሽትሞዓንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
verses.fr: Holon et sa banlieue, Debir et sa banlieue,
verses.am: ሖሎንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዳቤርንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
verses.fr: Aïn et sa banlieue, Jutta et sa banlieue, et Beth-Schémesch et sa banlieue, neuf villes de ces deux tribus;
verses.am: ዓይንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዮጣንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቤትሳሚስንና መሰምርያዋን፤ ከእነዚህ ከሁለቱ ነገዶች ዘጠኝ ከተሞችን ሰጡ።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
verses.fr: et de la tribu de Benjamin, Gabaon et sa banlieue, Guéba et sa banlieue,
verses.am: ከብንያምም ነገድ ገባዖንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ናሲብንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.fr: Anathoth et sa banlieue, et Almon et sa banlieue, quatre villes.
verses.am: አናቶትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ አልሞንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራት ከተሞችን ሰጡ።

verses.en: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.fr: Total des villes des sacrificateurs, fils d''Aaron: treize villes, et leurs banlieues.
verses.am: የአሮን ልጆች የካህናት ከተሞች ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር አሥራ ሦስት ናቸው።

verses.en: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.fr: Les Lévites appartenant aux familles des autres fils de Kehath eurent par le sort des villes de la tribu d''Ephraïm.
verses.am: ለቀሩትም ለቀዓት ልጆች ወገኖች ሌዋውያን የዕጣቸው ከተሞች ከኤፍሬም ነገድ ደረሱአቸው።

verses.en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.fr: On leur donna la ville de refuge pour les meurtriers, Sichem et sa banlieue, dans la montagne d''Ephraïm, Guézer et sa banlieue,
verses.am: በኤፍሬም ተራራማ አገር ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን ሴኬምንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ጌዝርንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.fr: Kibtsaïm et sa banlieue, et Beth-Horon et sa banlieue, quatre villes;
verses.am: ቂብጻይምንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቤትሖሮንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
verses.fr: de la tribu de Dan, Eltheké et sa banlieue, Guibbethon et sa banlieue,
verses.am: ከዳንም ነገድ ኤልተቄንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ገባቶንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ኤሎንንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.fr: Ajalon et sa banlieue, et Gath-Rimmon et sa banlieue, quatre villes;
verses.am: ጋትሪሞንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.fr: et de la demi-tribu de Manassé, Thaanac et sa banlieue, et Gath-Rimmon et sa banlieue, deux villes.
verses.am: ከምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ታዕናክንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ጋትሪሞንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ ሁለቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
verses.fr: Total des villes: dix, et leurs banlieues, pour les familles des autres fils de Kehath.
verses.am: የቀሩት የቀዓት ልጆች ወገኖች ከተሞች ሁሉ ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር አሥር ናቸው።

verses.en: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.fr: On donna aux fils de Guerschon, d''entre les familles des Lévites: de la demi-tribu de Manassé, la ville de refuge pour les meurtriers, Golan en Basan et sa banlieue, et Beeschthra et sa banlieue, deux villes;
verses.am: ለሌዋውያንም ወገኖች ለጌድሶን ልጆች ከምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ በባሳን ውስጥ የሆነችውን ጎላንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ በኤሽትራንና መሰምርያዋን፤ ሁለቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
verses.fr: de la tribu d''Issacar, Kischjon et sa banlieue, Dabrath et sa banlieue,
verses.am: ከይሳኮርም ነገድ ቂሶንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዳብራትንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs, Engannim with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.fr: Jarmuth et sa banlieue, et En-Gannim et sa banlieue, quatre villes;
verses.am: የርሙትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዓይንጋኒምንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.fr: de la tribu d''Aser, Mischeal et sa banlieue, Abdon et sa banlieue,
verses.am: ከአሴርም ነገድ ሚሽአልንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዓብዶንንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.fr: Helkath et sa banlieue, et Rehob et sa banlieue, quatre villes;
verses.am: ሔልቃትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ረአብንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammothdor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
verses.fr: et de la tribu de Nephthali, la ville de refuge pour les meurtriers, Kédesch en Galilée et sa banlieue, Hammoth-Dor et sa banlieue, et Karthan et sa banlieue, trois villes.
verses.am: ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን በገሊላ ውስጥ ቃዴስንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ሐሞትዶርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቀርታንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ ሦስቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.fr: Total des villes des Guerschonites, selon leurs familles: treize villes et leurs banlieues.
verses.am: የጌድሶን ልጆች ከተሞች ሁሉ በየወገኖቻቸው አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር ናቸው።

verses.en: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
verses.fr: On donna au reste des Lévites, qui appartenaient aux familles des fils de Merari: de la tribu de Zabulon, Jokneam et sa banlieue, Kartha et sa banlieue,
verses.am: ከሌዋውያንም ለቀሩት ለሜራሪ ልጆች ወገን ከዛብሎን ነገድ ዮቅንዓምንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.fr: Dimna et sa banlieue, et Nahalal et sa banlieue, quatre villes;
verses.am: ቀርታንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዲሞናንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ነህላልንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡ።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
verses.fr: de la tribu de Ruben, Betser et sa banlieue, Jahtsa et sa banlieue,
verses.am: ከሮቤልም ነገድ ቦሶርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ያሀጽንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.fr: Kedémoth et sa banlieue, et Méphaath et sa banlieue, quatre villes;
verses.am: ቅዴሞትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ሜፍዓትንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡ።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.fr: et de la tribu de Gad, la ville de refuge pour les meurtriers, Ramoth en Galaad et sa banlieue, Mahanaïm et sa banlieue,
verses.am: ከጋድም ነገድ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን በገለዓድ ውስጥ ራሞትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ መሃናይምንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
verses.fr: Hesbon et sa banlieue, et Jaezer et sa banlieue, en tout quatre villes.
verses.am: ሐሴቦንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ኢያዜርንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡ።

verses.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
verses.fr: Total des villes qui échurent par le sort aux fils de Merari, selon leurs familles, formant le reste des familles des Lévites: douze villes.
verses.am: ከሌዋውያን ወገኖች የቀሩት የሜራሪ ልጆች ከተሞች ሁሉ በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ዕጣቸውም አሥራ ሁለት ከተማ ነበረ።

verses.en: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
verses.fr: Total des villes des Lévites au milieu des propriétés des enfants d''Israël: quarante-huit villes, et leurs banlieues.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ልጆች ርስት መካከል የነበሩት የሌዋውያን ከተሞች ሁሉ አርባ ስምንት ከተሞችና መሰምርያቸው ነበሩ።

verses.en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
verses.fr: Chacune de ces villes avait sa banlieue qui l''entourait; il en était de même pour toutes ces villes.
verses.am: እነዚህም ከተሞች እያንዳንዳቸው ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር ነበሩ፤ እነዚህም ከተሞች ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que l''Eternel donna à Israël tout le pays qu''il avait juré de donner à leurs pères; ils en prirent possession et s''y établirent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ለአባቶቻቸው የማለላቸውን ምድር ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ሰጠ፤ ወረሱአትም፥ ተቀመጡባትም።

verses.en: And the Lord gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.fr: L''Eternel leur accorda du repos tout alentour, comme il l''avait juré à leurs pères; aucun de leurs ennemis ne put leur résister, et l''Eternel les livra tous entre leurs mains.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለአባቶቻቸው እንደ ማለላቸው በዙሪያቸው ካሉት አሳረፋቸው፤ ከጠላቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ይቋቋማቸው ዘንድ ማንም ሰው አልቻለም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ጠላቶቻቸውን ሁሉ በእጃቸው አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: There failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
verses.fr: De toutes les bonnes paroles que l''Eternel avait dites à la maison d''Israël, aucune ne resta sans effet: toutes s''accomplirent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ቤት ከተናገረው መልካም ነገር ሁሉ ተፈጸመ እንጂ ምንም አልቀረም።

verses.en: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.fr: Alors Josué appela les Rubénites, les Gadites et la demi-tribu de Manassé.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ኢያሱ የሮቤልን ልጆችና የጋድን ልጆች የምናሴንም ነገድ እኩሌታ ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው።

verses.en: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Vous avez observé tout ce que vous a prescrit Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, et vous avez obéi à ma voix dans tout ce que je vous ai ordonné.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ያዘዛችሁን ሁሉ ጠብቃችኋል፥ እኔም ላዘዝኋችሁ ነገር ሁሉ ታዝዛችኋል፤

verses.en: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Vous n''avez point abandonné vos frères, depuis un long espace de temps jusqu''à ce jour; et vous avez gardé les ordres, les commandements de l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ይህንም ያህል ብዙ ጊዜ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ወንድሞቻችሁን አልተዋችሁም፥ የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ጠብቃችኋል።

verses.en: And now the Lord your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side Jordan.
verses.fr: Maintenant que l''Eternel, votre Dieu, a accordé du repos à vos frères, comme il le leur avait dit, retournez et allez vers vos tentes, dans le pays qui vous appartient, et que Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, vous a donné de l''autre côté du Jourdain.
verses.am: አሁንም አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገራቸው ወንድሞቻችሁን አሳርፎአቸዋል፤ አሁን እንግዲህ ተመለሱ፥ ወደ ቤታችሁና የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደ ሰጣችሁ ወደ ርስታችሁ ምድር ሂዱ።

verses.en: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord charged you, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.fr: Ayez soin seulement d''observer et de mettre en pratique les ordonnances et les lois que vous a prescrites Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel: aimez l''Eternel, votre Dieu, marchez dans toutes ses voies, gardez ses commandements, attachez-vous à lui, et servez-le de tout votre coeur et de toute votre âme.
verses.am: ብቻ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ያዘዛችሁን ትእዛዙንና ሕጉን ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድዱ ዘንድ፥ መንገዱንም ሁሉ ትሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ትእዛዙንም ትጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ትጠጉ ዘንድ፥ በፍጹምም ልባችሁ በፍጹምም ነፍሳችሁ ታመልኩ ዘንድ እጅግ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
verses.fr: Et Josué les bénit et les renvoya, et ils s''en allèrent vers leurs tentes.
verses.am: ኢያሱም መረቃቸው፥ ሰደዳቸውም፤ ወደ ቤታቸውም ሄዱ።

verses.en: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
verses.fr: Moïse avait donné à une moitié de la tribu de Manassé un héritage en Basan, et Josué donna à l''autre moitié un héritage auprès de ses frères en deçà du Jourdain, à l''occident. Lorsque Josué les renvoya vers leurs tentes, il les bénit,
verses.am: ለምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ሙሴ በባሳን ውስጥ ርስት ሰጥቶአቸው ነበር፤ ለቀረው ለእኩሌታው ግን ኢያሱ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምዕራብ ወገን በወንድሞቻቸው መካከል ርስት ሰጣቸው። ኢያሱም ወደ ቤታቸው በሰደዳቸው ጊዜ እንዲህ ብሎ መረቃቸው።

verses.en: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
verses.fr: et leur dit: Vous retournez à vos tentes avec de grandes richesses, avec des troupeaux fort nombreux, et avec une quantité considérable d''argent, d''or, d''airain, de fer, et de vêtements. Partagez avec vos frères le butin de vos ennemis.
verses.am: በብዙ ብልጥግና በእጅግም ብዙ ከብት፥ በብርም፥ በወርቅም፥ በናስም፥ በብረትም፥ በእጅግም ብዙ ልብስ ወደ ቤታችሁ ተመለሱ፤ የጠላቶቻችሁንም ምርኮ ከወንድሞቻችሁ ጋር ተካፈሉ።

verses.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Les fils de Ruben, les fils de Gad, et la demi-tribu de Manassé, s''en retournèrent, après avoir quitté les enfants d''Israël à Silo, dans le pays de Canaan, pour aller dans le pays de Galaad, qui était leur propriété et où ils s''étaient établis comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné par Moïse.
verses.am: የሮቤልም ልጆች የጋድም ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ሄዱ፤ በሙሴም እጅ በተሰጠ በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ወደ ተቀበሉአት ወደ ርስታቸው ወደ ገለዓድ ምድር ይገቡ ዘንድ በከነዓን ምድር ካለችው ከሴሎ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
verses.fr: Quand ils furent arrivés aux districts du Jourdain qui appartiennent au pays de Canaan, les fils de Ruben, les fils de Gad et la demi-tribu de Manassé, y bâtirent un autel sur le Jourdain, un autel dont la grandeur frappait les regards.
verses.am: በከነዓን ምድር ወዳለው ወደ ዮርዳኖስ አቅራቢያም በመጡ ጊዜ የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ በዚያ በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ ታላቅ መሠዊያ ሠሩ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël apprirent que l''on disait: Voici, les fils de Ruben, les fils de Gad et la demi-tribu de Manassé, ont bâti un autel en face du pays de Canaan, dans les districts du Jourdain, du côté des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች። እነሆ፥ በከነዓን ምድር ዳርቻ በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ ባለው ግዛት፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ባሉበት ወገን፥ የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ መሠዊያ ሠርተዋል የሚል ወሬ ደረሰላቸው።

verses.en: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
verses.fr: Lorsque les enfants d''Israël eurent appris cela, toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël se réunit à Silo, pour monter contre eux et leur faire la guerre.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ወጥተው እነርሱን ሊዋጉ በሴሎ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël envoyèrent auprès des fils de Ruben, des fils de Gad et de la demi-tribu de Manassé, au pays de Galaad, Phinées, fils du sacrificateur Eléazar,
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በገለዓድ ምድር ወዳሉት ወደ ሮቤል ልጆችና ወደ ጋድ ልጆች ወደ ምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ የካህኑን የአልዓዛርን ልጅ ፊንሐስን ላኩ።

verses.en: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
verses.fr: et dix princes avec lui, un prince par maison paternelle pour chacune des tribus d''Israël; tous étaient chefs de maison paternelle parmi les milliers d''Israël.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር አሥር አለቆች ነበሩ፥ ከእስራኤል ከየነገዱ ሁሉ አንድ አንድ የአባቶች ቤት አለቃ፤ እያንዳንዱም በእስራኤል አእላፋት መካከል የእየአባቶቻቸው ቤት አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
verses.fr: Ils se rendirent auprès des fils de Ruben, des fils de Gad et de la demi-tribu de Manassé, au pays de Galaad, et ils leur adressèrent la parole, en disant:
verses.am: በገለዓድም ምድር ወዳሉት ወደ ሮቤል ልጆችና ወደ ጋድ ልጆች ወደ ምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ መጡ፥ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: Thus saith the whole congregation of the Lord, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the Lord, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the Lord?
verses.fr: Ainsi parle toute l''assemblée de l''Eternel: Que signifie cette infidélité que vous avez commise envers le Dieu d''Israël, et pourquoi vous détournez-vous maintenant de l''Eternel, en vous bâtissant un autel pour vous révolter aujourd''hui contre l''Eternel?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ማኅበር ሁሉ የሚለው ይህ ነው። ይህ በእስራኤል አምላክ ላይ ያደረጋችሁት ኃጢአት ምንድር ነው? ዛሬ እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል ተመልሳችኋል፤ ዛሬም መሠዊያ በመሥራታችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዐምፃችኋል።

verses.en: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the Lord,
verses.fr: Regardons-nous comme peu de chose le crime de Peor, dont nous n''avons pas jusqu''à présent enlevé la tache de dessus nous, malgré la plaie qu''il attira sur l''assemblée de l''Eternel?
verses.am: እኛ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከእርሱ ያልነጻንበት የፌጎር ኃጢአት ጥቂት ነውን? በእግዚአብሔር ማኅበር ላይ መቅሰፍት ወረደ።

verses.en: But that ye must turn away this day from following the Lord? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the Lord, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.
